title: Travis Kelce shares first details from his wedding to Taylor Swift: 'Best night of my life'
english: NFL star Travis Kelce recently opened up about his private July wedding to singer Taylor Swift, which took place at Madison Square Garden. He described the star-studded event, officiated by actor Adam Sandler, as the highlight of his life. The couple has kept the details of their marriage largely private, choosing not to release official photographs from the celebration.

title: Eurovision to bar countries at war from hosting: What that means
english: The European Broadcasting Union has introduced a new policy that prevents countries involved in active armed conflicts or geopolitical instability from hosting the Eurovision Song Contest. While affected nations can still participate as contestants, they will no longer be permitted to serve as the host country for the annual event. Organizers will now conduct independent security assessments to determine if a winning country is fit to host, or if an alternative location must be selected.

title: UK defends seizing shadow fleet tanker after Putin threat
english: The British government has upheld its decision to seize a Russian oil tanker suspected of violating international sanctions used to fund the war in Ukraine. President Vladimir Putin condemned the action as piracy and threatened to retaliate against Western vessels in any location. In response, UK officials stated the operation was conducted legally to disrupt Russia's illicit shadow fleet.

title: Russell Westbrook announces NBA retirement after 18 seasons
english: NBA superstar Russell Westbrook has officially retired from professional basketball after an impressive 18-year career. Known as the league's all-time leader in triple-doubles, the former MVP earned numerous honors, including nine All-Star selections and an Olympic gold medal. Over his extensive time on the court with seven different teams, he cemented his legacy as one of the most dynamic and competitive athletes in basketball history.

title: Life and loss as a first responder in southern Lebanon
english: Ali Safiuddin, the head of Civil Defence in Tyre, Lebanon, continues his rescue work despite enduring the personal tragedy of losing his young daughter during the 2006 conflict. While the city itself remains relatively stable, he frequently deals with the impact of ongoing strikes in nearby border areas. His traumatic past drives his commitment to saving others, as he views every life he rescues as a way to honor his daughter's memory.

title: What postcolonialism looks like in Southeast Asia
english: The article explores the ongoing influence and legacy of colonial history within Southeast Asian nations. It examines how these countries are navigating their postcolonial identities and addressing the lingering impacts of past foreign rule. Through a series of discussions, the piece highlights the complex political and social challenges that continue to shape the region today.

title: Japan protests as Russia’s Putin visits disputed Kuril Islands
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin recently visited the Kuril Islands, a territory Japan claims as its own since the Soviet Union seized them in 1945. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi condemned the trip as unacceptable, stating that the islands are historically Japanese territory. This visit further strained diplomatic relations between Tokyo and Moscow, which have already deteriorated due to Japan's support for Ukraine in the ongoing conflict.

Gochi kun hariiroo dippilomaasii Raashiyaafi Jaappaan gidduu jiru kan waraana Yuukireen irratti hundaa'e caalaatti kan hammeesse ta'uu gabaasameera.

title: Singapore-flagged container ship crashes into riverbank in India
english: A cargo ship registered in Singapore ran aground along the Hooghly River in eastern India. The incident occurred after the vessel experienced mechanical issues with its steering system while en route to the port of Kolkata. Authorities are currently managing the situation following the accidental collision with the riverbank.

title: US visa sanctions expose the limits of diplomatic pragmatism
english: The U.S. government is facing criticism for imposing visa restrictions on TPLF leaders, with critics arguing that this move prioritizes political convenience over essential justice for victims of atrocities. The author contends that ignoring accountability for genocide undermines the potential for a lasting peace in Ethiopia. By targeting those who demand justice and adherence to peace agreements, the U.S. is accused of betraying its own values and neglecting the necessity of truth in post-conflict transitions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በህወሓት መሪዎች ላይ የቪዛ ማዕቀብ መጣሉ ትችት እየገጠመው ነው። ተቺዎች ይህ ውሳኔ ለተፈጸሙ ግፍ ሰለባዎች ትክክለኛ ፍትህ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ለፖለቲካዊ ምቾት ቅድሚያ የሚሰጥ ነው ይላሉ። ደራሲው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀልን ተጠያቂነት ችላ ማለት በኢትዮጵያ ዘላቂ ሰላም ለመፍጠር የሚያስችል እድልን ያዳክማል ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ። አሜሪካ ፍትህን የሚጠይቁትን በመቅጣት የራሷን እሴቶች እንደከዳች እና ከግጭት በኋላ የሚመጣውን የሽግግር ሂደት አስፈላጊ እውነታ ችላ እንዳለች ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Amerikaa hoggantoota TPLF irratti uggura viizaa kaa'uun isaa qeeqa jabaa hordofsiiseera. Qeeqtoonni akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun miidhaa raawwatameef haqaa dhugaa kennuu irra faayidaa siyaasaa dura dursa kenna. Barreessaan kun akka jedhutti, duguuginsa sanyii raawwatameef itti gaafatamummaa dhabamsiisuun nagaa waaraa Itoophiyaa keessatti fiduu hin danda'u. Amerikaan haqaa fi kabajaa waliigaltee nagaa gaafatan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuun, duudhaalee ofii ishee akka gantee fi dhuga-ba'ii fi haqaa aadaa cehuumsa keessatti barbaachisu akka tuffatte ibsameera.

title: FIFA’s Infantino backed by six Arab federations including Qatar and Morocco
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has received a significant boost as six Arab football federations, including Qatar and Morocco, publicly declared their support for his leadership. This endorsement comes while Infantino faces calls to resign from major global confederations following a failed plan to secure private investment for FIFA. Despite this internal pressure ahead of next year's election, these key nations remain committed to his vision for developing the sport.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በኳታር እና ሞሮኮን ጨምሮ በስድስት የአረብ ሀገራት እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽኖች ድጋፍ አግኝተዋል። ይህ ድጋፍ የተሰጠው ኢንፋንቲኖ ለፊፋ ውድድሮች የግል ኢንቨስትመንት ለማስገባት ያቀረቡት ሀሳብ በመክሸፉ ምክንያት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከባድ ተቃውሞ እየገጠማቸው ባለበት ወቅት ነው። ለሚቀጥለው ዓመት ምርጫ እየተዘጋጁ ያሉትን ፕሬዝዳንቱን እነዚህ አገራት በስልጣን ላይ እንዲቆዩ ያላቸውን እምነት በይፋ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin FIFA Jaanni Iinfaantiinoo biyyoota Arabaa ja'a, kanneen akka Kaataar fi Moroookoo dabalatee, deeggarsa isaanii argataniiru. Deeggarsi kun kan dhufe, Iinfaantiinoon sagantaa FIFA keessatti investimantii dhuunfaa galchuuf qaban erga fashaleen booda, qondaaltota kubbaa miillaa idil-addunyaa biraa irraa dhiibbaan cimaan isaan irratti ka'ee jirutti. Akkuma gara fuulduraatti filannoon geggeeffamuuf jiruun, biyyoonni kun hojiin isaanii fi gaggeessummaan isaanii kan itti fufu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Pro-Palestine activists smear red paint on Danish defence company
english: Pro-Palestine demonstrators defaced the offices of Terma, a Danish defense manufacturer, by covering the building in red paint. The protesters targeted the firm to voice their opposition to its alleged role in supplying weaponry used during the conflict in Gaza. This act of vandalism was intended as a protest against the company's military production ties.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ደጋፊ አክቲቪስቶች በዴንማርክ የጦር መሳሪያ አምራች ኩባንያ ተርማ (Terma) ላይ ቀይ ቀለም በመቀባት ተቃውሟቸውን አሳይተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ኩባንያው በጋዛ በሚካሄደው ጦርነት ጥቅም ላይ በሚውሉ የጦር መሳሪያዎች ትርፍ እያገኘ ነው በማለት ተችተዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የኩባንያውን ወታደራዊ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ ለመቃወም የተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Deeggartoonni Falasxiin biyya Deenmaark keessatti argamu dhaabbata meeshaa waraanaa oomishu kan Terma jedhamu irratti gubbee diimaa dibuun mormii isaanii ibsataniiru. Mormitootni kun, dhaabbatichi waraana Gaaza keessatti meeshaalee waraanaa fayyadaman irraa bu'aa argata jedhanii komatu. Gochi kun dhaabbatichi hojii waraanaatiin walqabatee raawwatu mormuuf kan raawwatame dha.

title: Bangladesh humble Australia with worst total in contest as Hasan takes 6-55
english: Bangladesh dominated the first day of their Test match against Australia in Darwin by bowling the hosts out for just 198 runs. Hasan Mahmud delivered a career-best performance, claiming six wickets to help restrict the Australians to their lowest-ever total against Bangladesh. By the end of the day, the visitors responded strongly, reaching 96-1 and trailing by only 102 runs.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ በዳርዊን በተካሄደው የሙከራ ግጥሚያ የመጀመሪያ ቀን አውስትራሊያን በ198 ሩጫ ብቻ በመገደብ አስደናቂ ብቃት አሳይታለች። ሃሰን ማህሙድ ስድስት ውድ የሆኑ ዊኬቶችን በመውሰድ አውስትራሊያ ከባንግላዲሽ ጋር ካደረገችው ጨዋታዎች በታችኛው የውጤት መጠን እንዲያበቁ አድርጓል። ቀኑ ሲጠናቀቅ የባንግላዲሽ ተጫዋቾች 96 ሩጫ በማግኘት በአውስትራሊያ ላይ ጠንካራ ጫና ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Bangladesh guyyaa jalqabaa qormaata ishee Australia waliin Darwinitti taasisteen taphattoota Australia fiigicha 198 qofa irratti dhaabuu dandeesseetti. Hasan Mahmud wiciiketii ja'a fudhachuun qabxii isaa olaanaa galmeessiseera, kunis Australia qabxii hanga ammaatti Bangladesh waliin taphatte keessatti argatte keessaa isa gad-aanaa akka ta'u taasiseera. Guyyaan yeroo xumuramu, Bangladesh fiigicha 96 argachuun Australia irratti carraa gaarii qabdi.

title: Photos: Hope fades in Colombia as teams dig for earthquake survivors
english: A massive 7.4 magnitude earthquake has struck western Colombia, resulting in at least 265 deaths and thousands of injuries. Rescue teams are working tirelessly through debris in search of nearly 500 missing individuals, though expectations for finding survivors are decreasing as time passes. The government has declared a state of emergency and national mourning as citizens gather in temporary shelters for support.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በተከሰተው የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 265 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ከ3,500 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች አሁንም ከ500 በላይ የጠፉ ሰዎችን በፍርስራሽ ስር እየፈለጉ ቢሆንም፣ በህይወት የመገኘት ተስፋ እየቀነሰ መጥቷል። መንግስት በአገሪቱ የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ማወጁን ተከትሎ፣ የተጎዱ ዜጎች ጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎችን በመጠቀም ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti lafti socho’uu isaa hordofee namoonni 265 ol lubbuun isaanii darbeera, kuma sadii ol immoo miidhaniiru. Gareen gargaarsa namoomaa namoota 500 ol ta’an kan hin argamin bakka caccabaa keessatti barbaacha jiruus, abdii lubbuun argachuu hir’achaa dhufeera. Mootummaan biyyattii hatattamaa ta’ee fi gadda biyyoolessaa kan labse yoo ta’u, namoonni miidhaman qubannaa yeroo keessa jiraachaa jiru.

title: US diplomat calls Israeli settler siege of West Bank homes ‘act of terror’
english: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee has condemned an ongoing blockade of Palestinian homes in the West Bank village of Qusra by Israeli settlers as an act of terror. The settlers have cut off essential supplies like water and electricity to three families, including one with American citizenship, in an attempt to force them from their land. Despite initial attempts by Israeli security forces to clear the area, the families remain trapped and are refusing to abandon their properties.
amharic: የአሜሪካ አምባሳደር ማይክ ሃክቢ በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ ቁስራ መንደር የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች ላይ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን ከበባ እንደ ሽብርተኝነት ድርጊት አውግዘዋል። ሰፋሪዎቹ ውሃ እና ኤሌክትሪክን ጨምሮ መሰረታዊ አቅርቦቶችን በማቋረጥ ቤተሰቦቹን ከቀያቸው ለማፈናቀል እየሞከሩ ይገኛሉ፤ ከነዚህ ቤተሰቦች መካከል የአሜሪካ ዜግነት ያላቸውም ይገኙበታል። የእስራኤል የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ሰፋሪዎቹን ለማስለቀቅ ሙከራ ቢያደርጉም፣ ቤተሰቦቹ ቤታቸውን ለመልቀቅ ፈቃደኛ ሳይሆኑ አሁንም በእግድ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa Israa'elitti argaman Maayik Hakbii, qe'ee qonnaan bultoota Israa'el naannoo Qusraa ishee Qarqara Lixaatti maatiiwwan Falasxiin irratti gochaa jiran kan 'shororkeessummaa' ta'uu ibsanii jiru. Qonnaan bultoonni kunneen maatiiwwan sadii, kanneen keessaas lammiilee Ameerikaa jiran, bishaan, ibsaa fi meeshaalee barbaachisoo irraa kutuun lafa isaanii irraa ari'uuf yaalaa jiru. Humnoonni nageenyaa Israa'el qonnaan bultoota kana achi baasuuf yaalii taasisanillee, maatiiwwan kun iddoo isaanii gadhiisuu diduun ammas achuma keessatti hidhamanii jiru.

title: Pentagon tells Congress US killed 153 civilians in Yemen air strikes
english: A recent Pentagon report submitted to Congress reveals that US military operations in Yemen during 2025 resulted in 153 civilian deaths and 243 injuries. These airstrikes were launched following President Trump's order to target Houthi forces in response to their attacks on Red Sea shipping. The document specifically highlighted high-casualty incidents in Sanaa and Hodeidah, with some actions facing calls for war crime investigations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ለኮንግረስ ባቀረበው ሪፖርት መሠረት፣ ባለፈው ዓመት በየመን በተካሄዱ የአየር ጥቃቶች 153 ንጹሃን ዜጎች መገደላቸውንና 243 መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት በቀይ ባህር የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ለሚደርሰው ጥቃት ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው። ሪፖርቱ በሳንዓ እና በሁዳይዳ የተፈጸሙ ገዳይ ጥቃቶችን በዝርዝር የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ በአንዳንድ ክስተቶች ላይ የጦር ወንጀል ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Gabaasni Ministeera Ittisa Biyyaa Ameerikaa gara Koongiresiitti ergame akka mul'isutti, bara darbe Yemen keessatti haleellaa qilleensaa Ameerikaan gaggeessiteen namoonni nagaa 153 du'anii 243 ammoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame loltoonni Huutii markaboota galaana diimaa keessa jiran irratti haleellaa waan raawwataniif Pirezidaant Traamp ajaja kennanii dha. Gabaasichi magaalaalee Sanaa fi Hodeidaa keessatti haleellaa ga'e ibsuudhaan, gochoota tokko tokko irratti qorannoon yakka waraanaa akka gaggeeffamu gaafatameera.

title: Gaza death toll reaches 73,389
english: The Palestinian health ministry reports that recent Israeli strikes in the Gaza Strip have resulted in at least one death and seven injuries. This latest violence adds to the ongoing conflict that began in October 2023. Current records indicate that the total number of Palestinians killed has now climbed to over 73,000, with more than 174,000 people wounded.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ጤና ሚኒስቴር እንደገለጸው በእስራኤል በጋዛ ሰርጥ በተፈጸመ የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥቃት ቢያንስ አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ሰባት ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ከጥቅምት 2016 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ግጭት ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው። አሁን ባለው መረጃ መሰረት በጋዛ የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ73,000 በላይ የደረሰ ሲሆን ከ174,000 በላይ ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri Fayyaa Filisxeem akka gabaasetti, haleellaa Israa'el daangaa Gaazaa keessatti raawwatte kanaan namni tokko yoo du'u, torban immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun waraana Adoolessa 2023 jalqabee itti fufe keessatti kan dabalameedha. Akka ragaa amma jiruutti, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii 73,000 kan caale yoo ta'u, namoonni 174,000 ol ta'an immoo miidhaan irra ga'eera.

title: Mecca Defence Agreement will include political and military coordination, Turkey says
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have established a new defense agreement that focuses on closer political and military collaboration. This partnership involves high-level meetings between the nations' defense and foreign officials alongside their military leaders. The alliance aims to organize joint military drills and foster cooperation in defense manufacturing and technological development.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን በፖለቲካ እና በወታደራዊ ዘርፍ የጠበቀ ትብብር ለማድረግ የሚያስችል አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ስምምነቱ የሦስቱን ሀገራት የመከላከያና የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች እንዲሁም የጦር አዛዦች ያካተተ የምክክር መድረክ ይፈጥራል። አጋርነቱ በጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶችን ለማከናወን እና በመከላከያ ኢንዱስትሪና ቴክኖሎጂ ሽግግር ላይ በጋራ ለመስራት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Turkey, Saudi Arabia fi Pakistan waligaltee ittisaa haaraa kan siyaasaa fi waraanaan walitti dhiyeenya uumu mallatteessaniiru. Waligalteen kun ministiroota ittisaa, ministiroota dhimma alaa fi qondaaltota waraanaa biyyoota sadanii walitti fiduun kan qophaaye dha. Tumsi kun leenjii waraanaa waliinii gaggeessuu fi oomisha meeshaalee waraanaa akkasumas guddina teeknooloojii irratti walta'iinsaan hojjechuuf kan karoorfate dha.

title: Salvage operation for stricken tanker off Omani coast begins
english: A salvage operation is underway to stabilize the Caroline Bezengi, a Cameroon-flagged tanker that has been stranded off the coast of Oman since early June following an unexplained explosion. Environmental authorities have confirmed that oil from the vessel has already polluted approximately 40 kilometers of the Omani shoreline. Western officials believe the ship is involved in transporting sanctioned Russian oil, raising concerns about a potential large-scale environmental disaster.
amharic: ሰኔ መጀመሪያ ላይ ያልታወቀ ፍንዳታ የገጠማት የካሜሮን ባንዲራ የምታውለበልበው የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከብ በኦማን የባህር ጠረፍ ላይ በመቆሟ የነፍረ-አድን ስራ እየተከናወነ ይገኛል። የኦማን የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ባለስልጣናት ከመርከቧ የፈሰሰው ነዳጅ ወደ 40 ኪሎ ሜትር የሚጠጋውን የባህር ጠረፍ መበከሉን አረጋግጠዋል። ምዕራባውያን መንግስታት መርከቧ የሩሲያን ማዕቀብ የተጣለበትን ነዳጅ ለማጓጓዝ የምትጠቀምበት የጥላ መርከቦች ቡድን አካል እንደሆነች በመግለጽ፣ ሁኔታው መጠነ ሰፊ የአካባቢ ጥፋት ሊያስከትል እንደሚችል ስጋት ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Markabii gosa 'Caroline Bezengi' jedhamu kan alaabaa Kaameruun qabateefi ji'a Waxabajjii keessa balaa dhohiinsaatiin ganda Omaanitti dhaabbate tasgabbeessuuf hojiin fayyinsaa eegalameera. Abbootiin taayitaa naannichaa akka mirkaneessanitti, dhangala'aan boba'aa markabicha keessaa ba'e qarqara galaana Omaan hamma kiilomeetira 40 ta'u faaleera. Mootummoonni lixaa markabni kun boba'aa Raashiyaa irratti tateen jiru guuruuf kan gargaaramaniifi garee 'shadow fleet' jedhamu keessaa akka ta'e dubbatanis, balaa naannoo guddaa qaqqabsiisuu danda'a jedhanii yaaddoo qabu.

title: Maersk CEO says conditions right to increase transit through Suez
english: Maersk's CEO expects the shipping giant to resume full transit through the Suez Canal by 2026, provided that security in Yemen remains stable. While the company recently reported strong financial results, it continues to monitor regional threats posed by Houthi attacks in the Red Sea. Along with partner Hapag-Lloyd, Maersk will gradually evaluate safety before finalizing its return to this critical trade route.
amharic: የማርስክ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ በየመን ያለው የፀጥታ ሁኔታ የተረጋጋ ከሆነ ኩባንያው እ.ኤ.አ በ2026 ሙሉ በሙሉ በስዊዝ ቦይ በኩል መጓጓዣውን ለመቀጠል እንዳቀደ ገልጸዋል። ኩባንያው ጠንካራ የገቢ ውጤቶችን እያስመዘገበ ቢሆንም በቀይ ባህር ውስጥ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሚደርሱትን ጥቃቶች በቅርበት እየተከታተለ ይገኛል። ከባልደረባዋ ሀፓግ-ሎይድ ጋር በመሆን ለደህንነት ሲባል የጉዞ መስመሩን ሁኔታ በጥንቃቄ እየገመገሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hogganaan olaanaa dhaabbata Maersk akka ibsetti, yoo haalli nageenyaa Yamanitti tasgabbaa’e, dhaabbatichi bara 2026 irraa eegalee daandii bishaan Suez guutumaan guutuutti fayyadamuu akka jalqabu abdii qaba. Dhaabbatichi bu’aa kaffaltii cimaa galmeessisus, haleellaa garee Huutii kan Galaana Diimaa keessatti raawwatamu hordofaa jira. Maersk dhaabbata Hapag-Lloyd wajjin ta’uun, nageenya qorachuun daandii daldalaa kanaatti deebi’uuf qophii taasisaa jira.

title: National Bank Forces Anbesa Bank Board Re-run, All Incumbents Out
english: The National Bank of Ethiopia mandated a new board election for Anbesa Bank after rejecting the previous results due to internal conflicts that threatened the institution's stability. During a supervised assembly held on August 8, 2026, shareholders voted for an entirely new group of 11 directors, removing all members of the former board. This leadership overhaul is intended to resolve long-standing disputes and ensure better governance for the bank and its depositors.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ብሄራዊ ባንክ በአንበሳ ባንክ የቀድሞ የቦርድ ምርጫ ላይ አለመግባባቶች በመፈጠሩ እና የባንኩን ደህንነት ስጋት ላይ በመጣሉ ምርጫው እንዲደገም አዟል። በዚህም መሰረት ነሐሴ 8 ቀን 2026 በተካሄደው ስብሰባ ባለአክሲዮኖች 11 አዳዲስ የቦርድ አባላትን በመምረጥ የነበሩትን ሙሉ በሙሉ አንስተዋል። ይህ አዲስ አመራር የባንኩን የአስተዳደር ችግሮች ለመፍታት እና ለተቀማጮች መረጋጋት ለማምጣት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Baankiin Biyyaalessaa Itoophiyaa, walitti buiinsa keessoo baankichaaf sodaachisaa ta'e hordofee, filannoon boordii Baankii Anbasaa duraanii akka haquufi irra deebi'amee akka gaggeeffamu ajaje. Fulbaana 8, 2026 walgahii addaa gaggeeffameen, qooda fudhattoonni miseensota boordii 11 haaraa filachuun miseensota boordii duraanii hunda bakka buusaniiru. Jijjiiramni gaggeessummaa kun rakkoolee bulchiinsa baankichaa furuufi nageenya qusattootaa eeguuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: The Storm Passed, the Freight Bill Did Not
english: A Bishoftu-based flower farm, Vegpro, has successfully recovered from a devastating storm that destroyed its greenhouses last year. However, the business is now facing a new crisis due to significant spikes in global shipping and transportation costs caused by regional instability. These rising freight prices are severely straining the company's thin profit margins, as it struggles to remain competitive in the European flower market.
amharic: ቢሾፍቱ የሚገኘው ቬግፕሮ የተባለ የአበባ እርሻ ከአንድ ዓመት በፊት በደረሰው አውሎ ንፋስ የደረሰበትን ጉዳት አስተካክሎ ወደ ስራ ቢመለስም አሁን ደግሞ በዓለም አቀፍ የጭነት ማጓጓዣ ዋጋ መናር ምክንያት ሌላ ፈተና ገጥሞታል። በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ባለው አለመረጋጋት የተነሳ የትራንስፖርት ወጪዎች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመራቸው የኩባንያውን ትርፍ በእጅጉ እየጎዳው ይገኛል። አነስተኛ የትርፍ ህዳግ ባለው የአበባ ገበያ ውስጥ የሚንቀሳቀሰው ይህ ድርጅት፣ አሁን ካለው የዋጋ ጭማሪ ጋር ተያይዞ በአውሮፓ ገበያ ተወዳዳሪ ሆኖ ለመቀጠል እየተቸገረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Qonnaan beeytii abaaboo Bishoftuutti argamtu kan Vegpro jedhamtu, ganna darbe bubbeen maasii ishee irratti miidhaa erraan gahee booda deebitee haala gaariin ijaarramtee jirti. Haa ta'u malee, yeroo ammaa kana rakkoon geejjibaa fi gatiin fe'umsaa idil-addunyaa dabaluun isaa qabeenya isaanii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumaa jira. Walitti bu'iinsa naannawa biyyoota giddu galeessa bahaa irraa kan ka'e baasii geejjibaa fi fe'umsaa dabaluun isaa, qonnaan beeytittiin gabaa Awurooppaa irratti dorgomtuu ta'ee itti fufuuf qormaata guddaa keessa galteetti.

title: The Hotel That Housed the OAU Meets the Wrecking Ball
english: Ethiopia Hotel, a historic landmark in Addis Ababa known for hosting the 1963 OAU founding, is currently being demolished to make way for a modern tower. The owner, BK Group, plans to replace the six-decade-old structure with a larger, contemporary complex. While this redevelopment marks a significant change for the city, it has also sparked concerns regarding the preservation of historical landmarks in the capital.
amharic: የአፍሪካ አንድነት ድርጅትን የመመስረቻ ስብሰባን በማስተናገድ የሚታወቀውና በአዲስ አበባ ታሪካዊ ምልክት የሆነው ኢትዮጵያ ሆቴል፣ በአዲስ ዘመናዊ ሕንፃ ለመተካት እየፈረሰ ነው። የሆቴሉ ባለቤት የሆነው ቢኬ ግሩፕ፣ ከስድስት አስርት ዓመታት በላይ አገልግሎት የሰጠውን የድሮ ሕንፃ በማፍረስ ዘመናዊ ግንባታ ለማካሄድ እቅድ አውጥቷል። ሆኖም ይህ የከተማዋን ገጽታ የሚቀይር ግንባታ፣ የታሪካዊ ቅርሶች ጥበቃን በተመለከተ በከተማዋ ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Hoteelli Itoophiyaa kan durii, kan hundeeffama gamtaa Afrikaa (OAU) bara 1963 keessummeessuun beekamu, bakka isaa gamoo ammayyaa ijaaruuf diigamaa jira. Abbaan qabeenyaa isaa, gareen BK, gamoolee waggaa ja’atamii oliif tajaajila kennan diigee bakka isaanii bakka ammayyaa ijaaruuf karoorfateera. Diigamni kun, guddina magaalaa Finfinnee keessatti jijjiirama guddaa fiduus, dhimmichi eegumsa seenaa fi bakkeewwan seena qabeeyyii irratti gaaffii uumee jira.

title: Tax on Alcohol, Tobacco Worked. Study Finds That May Be the Problem
english: Ethiopia's excise tax on alcohol and tobacco has successfully increased government revenue and reduced legal sales, but it is causing unintended consequences. Many consumers are avoiding higher prices by switching to unregulated homemade alcohol and illicit cigarettes. Researchers warn that this shift not only undermines the tax's effectiveness but also moves consumption into markets that bypass safety regulations and government oversight.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ በአልኮል እና በሲጋራ ላይ የተጣለው የኤክሳይስ ታክስ የመንግስትን ገቢ በመጨመር ህጋዊ ሽያጮችን ለመቀነስ ቢሳካም ያልታሰበ ችግር ፈጥሯል። ብዙ ሸማቾች የዋጋ ጭማሪውን በመሸሽ ወደ ቤት ውስጥ ወደሚጠመቁ መጠጦች እና ህገ-ወጥ ሲጋራዎች እያመሩ ይገኛሉ። ተመራማሪዎች ይህ ሁኔታ የታክሱ ትርፍ እየቀነሰ መምጣቱን ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ ህገ-ወጥ የገበያ እንቅስቃሴዎች እንዲስፋፉ እና የጤና ቁጥጥር እንዲዳከም እያደረገ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Gibirri alkoolii fi tamboo irratti biyya keenyatti godhame galii mootummaa dabaluu fi gurgurtaa seera qabeessa hir'isuu irratti milkaa'us, rakkoo biraa fiduu danda'eera. Maamiltoonni hedduun gatii dabale kana baqachuudhaan gara dhugaatii mana keessatti qophaa'uu fi tamboo seeraan alatti gurguramutti jijjiiramaa jiru. Qorattoonni akka ibsanitti, jijjiiramni kun bu'aa gibirichi qabu xiqqeessuu qofa osoo hin taane, gabaa seeraan alaa babal'isuu fi to'annoo fayyaa dadhabsiisuu danda'a.

title: Bus Firms Spend Hundreds of Millions, Hit Bank, Tariff, Charging Walls
english: Three major inter-city transport companies have invested 450 million Birr to upgrade their fleets to comply with new government regulations. However, these businesses now face serious financial risks due to high taxes, difficult bank lending conditions, and a lack of necessary infrastructure like charging stations. The operators argue that inconsistent government policies and the removal of previously agreed-upon incentives are threatening their massive investments.
amharic: ሶስት ዋና ዋና የከተማ አቋራጭ የትራንስፖርት ድርጅቶች የመንግስትን አዲስ መመሪያ ለማክበር 450 ሚሊዮን ብር ወጪ በማድረግ አዳዲስ አውቶቡሶችን ገዝተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ድርጅቶቹ በከፍተኛ ታክስ፣ በብድር እጥረት እና እንደ ኃይል መሙያ ጣቢያ ባሉ መሰረተ ልማቶች አለመሟላት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ኪሳራ አደጋ ውስጥ መውደቃቸውን ገልጸዋል። በተደጋጋሚ የሚቀያየሩ የመንግስት ፖሊሲዎች እና ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ ጥቅማጥቅሞች መቅረታቸው ኢንቨስትመንታቸውን አደጋ ላይ እንደጣለባቸው ቅሬታቸውን ያቀርባሉ።
oromo: Dhaabbileen geejjiba magaalaota gidduu hojjetan sadan, qajeelfama mootummaan haaraa baase kabajuuf jecha gabaa birrii miiliyoona 450 baasanii konkolaattota haaraa bitaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, gibira ol'aanaa, hanqina liqii baankii fi hanqina bu'uuraalee misoomaa akka buufata chaarjii jiran irraa kan ka'e, dhaabbileen kun rakkoo dinagdee cimaa keessa seenaniiru. Abbootiin qabeenyaa kun, jijjiirama siyaasaa mootummaa fi haquma faayidaa duraan walii galameefiin invastimantiin isaanii balaaf saaxilamuu isaatiif komii dhiyeeffataa jiru.

title: More troops to be sent to West Bank village besieged by Israeli settlers
english: The Israeli military is deploying more soldiers to a West Bank village after failing to remove settlers who have besieged two Palestinian families for several days. These families have been trapped without power, water, or sufficient food, sparking significant international concern. U.S. officials have condemned the violence and pressured Israel to intervene as the military struggles to control settler actions in the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በዌስት ባንክ መንደር ለብዙ ቀናት ሁለት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦችን ከበው የያዙ ሰፋሪዎችን ማስወጣት ባለመቻላቸው ተጨማሪ ወታደሮችን ለመላክ ተገደዋል። ቤተሰቦቹ ያለ ኤሌክትሪክ፣ ውሃ እና ምግብ በመታሰራቸው ዓለም አቀፍ ትኩረትን ስቧል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ጥቃት በማውገዝ እስራኤል ፈጣን እርምጃ እንድትወስድ ግፊት እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ እስራኤልም በሰፋሪዎች ላይ ቁጥጥር ለማድረግ እየተቸገረች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el maatiiwwan Falasxiin lama guyyoota hedduuf naannawa Qusraa keessatti marfaman gadhiisiisuu waan dadhabeef, waraana dabalataa gara naannichaatti ergaa jira. Maatiiwwan kunneen bishaan, ibsaa fi nyaata malee hidhamanii turuun isaanii yaaddoo addunyaa kaasee jira. Aangottonni Ameerikaa gocha kana balaaleeffachuun Israa'el tarkaanfii akka fudhattu gaafataniiru, mootummaan Israa'el garuu gocha raawwattoota kana to'achuuf rakkachaa jira.

title: Indian actor's video with endangered gibbon sparks investigation
english: Indian actor Vikram is facing an official investigation after posting a video on social media showing him interacting with an endangered lar gibbon. Wildlife authorities are looking into how the protected animal ended up in a private residence in Chennai and whether its possession follows legal requirements. While the actor has not yet issued a statement, officials are currently verifying if the gibbon was obtained and imported in accordance with international wildlife trade regulations.
amharic: የህንድ ተዋናይ ቪክራም አደጋ ላይ ያለ ዝርያ የሆነውን 'ላር ጊቦን' የተባለ የዝንጀሮ ዓይነት አቅፎ የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ከለቀቀ በኋላ ምርመራ እየተካሄደበት ነው። የዱር እንስሳት ጥበቃ ባለስልጣናት እንስሳው በቼናይ በሚገኝ የግል መኖሪያ ቤት ውስጥ እንዴት እንደገባ እና አያያዙ ህጋዊ መሆኑን እያጣሩ ነው። ተዋናዩ እስካሁን በጉዳዩ ላይ ምንም አይነት መግለጫ ያልሰጠ ሲሆን ባለስልጣናት እንስሳው በአለም አቀፍ ህግ መሰረት በህጋዊ መንገድ መግባቱን ለማረጋገጥ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Aartistiin biyya Indiyaa Viikraam, fakkii sochiilee miidiyaa irratti bineensa gosa 'laar gibboon' jedhamu kan baduuf jedhu waliin taphachaa jiru erga gadhiisee booda qorannoon irra gaggeeffamaa jira. Qondaaltonni eegumsa bineensotaa, bineensi kun akkamitti manatti akka dhufeefi qabiinsi isaa seera qabeessa ta'uu isaa qulqulleeffachaa jiru. Aartistichi hanga ammaatti ibsa kan hin kennine yoo ta'u, qondaaltonni bineensi kun seera addunyaa kabajuun gara biyyattii galee jiraachuu isaa mirkaneeffachuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: How to stay safe during an earthquake: A visual guide
english: To stay safe during an earthquake, it is essential to prepare your home by securing heavy furniture and creating an emergency kit with basic supplies like water, food, and medicine. When shaking occurs, remain indoors and avoid running outside to protect yourself from falling debris. After the earthquake stops, check for injuries and remain alert for potential hazards like gas leaks or aftershocks.
amharic: የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በሚከሰትበት ጊዜ ደህንነትን ለመጠበቅ ከባድ የቤት እቃዎችን ማሰር እና እንደ ውሃ፣ ምግብ እና መድሃኒት ያሉ አስፈላጊ ቁሳቁሶችን የያዘ የአደጋ ጊዜ ቦርሳ ማዘጋጀት በጣም አስፈላጊ ነው። መንቀጥቀጡ ሲጀምር ከህንጻ ውጭ ከመሮጥ ይልቅ በቤት ውስጥ መቆየት ከሚወድቁ ነገሮች ይከላከላል። መንቀጥቀጡ ካቆመ በኋላ በሰውነትዎ ላይ ጉዳት መኖሩን ያረጋግጡ እና እንደ ጋዝ ፍሳሽ ወይም ተከታታይ መንቀጥቀጦች ያሉ አደጋዎች ስለሚኖሩ ጥንቃቄ ያድርጉ።
oromo: Gidiraa dachee yeroo raafamu of eeggannoo gochuuf, mana keessatti meeshaalee ulfaatoo hidhuu fi qophii hatattamaa kan akka bishaan, nyaata, fi qoricha walitti qabachun murteessadha. Yeroo raafamni jalqabu, ala fiigun balaa jiru waan dabaluuf, mana keessatti tasgabbaa'anii turuun irra caala. Erga raafamni dhaabatee booda, miidhaan jiraachu isaa of haa qorannu akkasumas balaa biraa kan akka xiriirri gaazii ykn raafama lammaffaa irratti xiyyeeffannoo haa kenninu.

title: Part of children’s hospital collapses in Colombia earthquake
english: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck Cali, Colombia, on Monday, causing a section of a local children's hospital to crumble. Security footage recorded the building's partial collapse during the tremor. The disaster has resulted in at least 265 confirmed fatalities, with many other individuals currently reported as missing.
amharic: ሰኞ ዕለት በኮሎምቢያ ካሊ ከተማ በተከሰተ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ የህፃናት ሆስፒታል ህንፃ ከፊል ክፍል ወድቋል። የደህንነት ካሜራዎች ህንፃው ሲፈርስ የተቀረጸውን ምስል ያሳዩ ሲሆን፣ እስካሁን በደረሰው አደጋ ቢያንስ 265 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አሁንም በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የት እንዳሉ አልታወቀም።
oromo: Dilbata darbe biyya Kolombiyaa magaalaa Kaalii keessatti sochiin lafaa humni isaa 7.4 ta’e mudatee hospitaala daa’immanii tokkoo irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Kaameraawwan nageenyaa bakki hospitaalichaa tokko yeroo diigamu suuraa kaasaniru. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 265 olii darbeera, namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa’amanis hanga ammaatti eessa akka jiran hin beekamu.

title: As temperatures soar, ‘exceptionally serious’ drought imperils UK farmers
english: Farmers in the United Kingdom are facing a severe agricultural crisis due to record-breaking heat and a lack of rainfall, which has left much of the country in a state of drought. The persistent dry conditions have caused crop yields to plummet and damaged soil health, forcing many producers to call for urgent government support. Experts warn that this recurring pattern of extreme weather is an increasingly serious threat to the nation's food production.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን እና የዝናብ እጥረት በመከሰቱ ገበሬዎች ከባድ የግብርና ቀውስ ውስጥ ገብተዋል። በሀገሪቱ በአብዛኛው አካባቢዎች የተከሰተው ድርቅ የምርት መጠን እንዲቀንስ እና የአፈር ሁኔታ እንዲበላሽ ስላደረገ፣ አምራቾች አስቸኳይ የመንግስት ድጋፍ እንዲደረግላቸው እየጠየቁ ነው። ባለሙያዎች ይህ በተደጋጋሚ የሚከሰት ከፍተኛ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ለሀገሪቱ የምግብ ዋስትና ከፍተኛ ስጋት እየፈጠረ መሆኑን ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Biyyoota Gamtoomanii keessatti ho'i baay'ee fi roobni hir'achuu isaatiin walqabatee qotee bultoonni rakkoo cimaa keessa galaniiru. Hanqinni roobaa kun omisha gadi buusuu fi qulqullina biyyee irratti dhiibbaa waan geessiseef, qotee bultoonni mootummaan gargaarsa ariifachiisaa akka godhuuf gaafachaa jiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, haalli qilleensaa hamaa ta'e kun irra deddeebi'ee mudachuun isaa nageenya nyaataa biyyattii irratti balaa guddaa agarsiisa.

title: Three US states to hold executions on same day for first time since 2010
english: For the first time since 2010, three U.S. states—Tennessee, Alabama, and Oklahoma—are scheduled to carry out executions on the same day. Each inmate involved was convicted of murder, and these events occur despite a long-term national decline in public support for capital punishment. This rare triple execution highlights ongoing debates regarding the death penalty in the United States.
amharic: ከ2010 ወዲህ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ሶስት የአሜሪካ ግዛቶች ማለትም ቴነሲ፣ አላባማ እና ኦክላሆማ በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ የሞት ፍርድ ለመፈጸም ተዘጋጅተዋል። በነዚህ ግዛቶች የሚፈጸሙት ግድያዎች ከባድ የወንጀል ድርጊት ፈጽመዋል በተባሉ እስረኞች ላይ የሚካሄዱ ናቸው። ምንም እንኳን በአሜሪካ የሞት ቅጣትን የሚደግፉ ሰዎች ቁጥር እየቀነሰ ቢመጣም፣ ይህ ክስተት በሀገሪቱ የሞት ቅጣት አሰጣጥ ላይ ትኩረትን ስቧል።
oromo: Akkuma bara 2010 booda yeroo jalqabaatiif, mootummoonni naannoo Ameerikaa sadan—Tennessee, Alabama fi Oklahoma—guyyaa tokkotti namoota adabbii du'aa itti murtaa'e ajjeesuuf qophaa'aniiru. Namoonni ajjeefaman kunneen hundi yakka ajjeechaa raawwachuun kan itti murtaa'aniidha. Ta'us, Ameerikaa keessatti namoonni adabbii du'aa morman dabalaa dhufuun beekamus, raawwiin kun seera adabbii du'aa irratti marii kaaseera.

title: Swiatek sinks Svitolina to set up Rybakina title clash in Toronto
english: Iga Swiatek defeated Elina Svitolina in the Toronto semifinals to secure a spot in the final. She will compete for the championship title against Elena Rybakina, who advanced after a comeback victory over Coco Gauff. This match marks Swiatek's first final appearance of the year as both players prepare for the upcoming US Open.
amharic: ኢጋ ስዋይቴክ በቶሮንቶ የግማሽ ፍጻሜ ጨዋታ ኤሊና ስቪቶሊናን በማሸነፍ ለፍጻሜ ደርሳለች። ለዋንጫው የምትፋለመው ደግሞ ኮኮ ጋፍን በመርታት ለፍጻሜ የደረሰችውን ኤሌና ሪባኪናን ነው። ይህ ውድድር ሁለቱም ተጫዋቾች ለሚመጣው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር እየተዘጋጁ ባለበት ወቅት፣ ስዋይቴክ በዚህ ዓመት ለፍጻሜ ስታልፍ የመጀመሪያዋ ነው።
oromo: Iga Swiatek tapha semi-fainalii Tooroontoo irratti Elina Svitolina mo'achuun gara fainaliitti darbiteetti. Igaan qophii tapha xumuraa irratti kan qunnamtu taphataan biyya Kaazaakistaan Elena Rybakina yoo taatu, isheenis Coco Gauff injifachuun xumuraaf ga'eetti. Taphoonni kun qophii dorgommii US Open irratti ta'uuf, Igaaf bara kanaaf yeroo jalqabaaf gara tapha xumuraa kan ishee geessise dha.

title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz is under its control
english: A senior Iranian official claims that Iran holds authority over the Strait of Hormuz. This statement serves as a direct rebuttal to US President Donald Trump, who recently asserted that America maintains full control of the vital shipping route. The conflicting declarations highlight ongoing geopolitical tensions regarding the management of this strategic waterway.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣን የሆርሙዝ የባሕር መተላለፊያ በኢራን ቁጥጥር ሥር መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ አሜሪካ በዚሁ የባሕር መስመር ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዳላት የገለጹትን የአሜሪካውን ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ንግግር የሚቃረን ነው። የሁለቱ ወገኖች ተቃራኒ አቋም በዚህ ስልታዊ የባሕር መስመር አስተዳደር ዙሪያ ያለውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran akka jedhanitti, daandiin galaana Hormuz gama isaanitiin to’atamaa jira. Ibsi kun kan kenname, pirezidaantiin Amerika Donald Trump daandii galaana kanaa guutumaan guutuutti to’ataa akka jiran dubbachuu isaanii hordofee dha. Wal dhabdee ibsa kanaanis, nageenya daandii galaana kanaa irratti wal dhabdee siyaasaa jiru agarsiisa.

title: British maritime company engaged in salvage of stricken vessel off Omani coast
english: A British maritime security firm named Ambrey is currently managing the rescue of a tanker called Caroline Bezengi near the coast of Oman. Additional salvage ships have been dispatched to assist with the recovery efforts. The situation is being actively monitored to ensure the vessel is safely secured.
amharic: አምብሬ የተባለ የብሪታኒያ የባህር ደህንነት ኩባንያ በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ ችግር ላይ የወደቀውን ካሮሊን ቤዘንጊ የተባለ መርከብ የማዳን ስራ እያከናወነ ይገኛል። ለዚህ ኦፕሬሽን ድጋፍ እንዲሰጡ ተጨማሪ የማዳኛ መርከቦች ወደ ስፍራው እየተጓዙ ነው። መርከቧን በሰላም ለማዳን የሚደረገው ጥረት ተጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni nageenya galaana beekamaa kan Biriiteen Ambrey jedhamu, doonii 'Caroline Bezengi' jedhamtuu fi qarqara galaana Omaan irratti rakkoo keessa seente tasgabbessuuf hojjechaa jira. Hojii kana deggaruuf dooniiwwan gargaarsa biroo gara iddoo sanatti ergamaniiru. Hojiin doonii kana fayyisuuf taasifamu xiyyeeffannoon itti fufuun isaa ibsameera.

title: Morning update
english: Yemen's leadership has rejected a deal with the Houthis, seeking a peace that restores state control over weaponry. Meanwhile, Iraq has vowed to protect its sovereignty by banning the use of its territory for attacks against neighbors, and US officials have expressed doubt regarding reported Iranian threats against Donald Trump. Additionally, Iranian officials criticized Western nations over their support for Israel, while Hamas condemned a recent Israeli airstrike in Gaza for undermining ceasefire negotiations.
amharic: የየመን የአመራር ምክር ቤት ከሁቲዎች ጋር ስምምነት ለማድረግ ፈቃደኛ እንዳልሆነ አስታውቆ፣ በምትኩ የመንግስት የጦር መሳሪያ ቁጥጥር የሚያረጋግጥ ዘላቂ ሰላም እንደሚፈልግ ገልጿል። በሌላ በኩል፣ ኢራቅ የራሷን ሉዓላዊነት ለመጠበቅ ሲባል ግዛቷ ለጎረቤት ሀገራት ጥቃት እንዳይውል ከልክላለች። በተያያዘም የዩኤስ የስለላ ባለስልጣናት ስለ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የህይወት ስጋት የቀረበውን መረጃ አጠራጣሪ ብለውታል። ሀማስ በበኩሉ፣ በእስራኤል የተፈጸመው የአየር ድብደባ የተኩስ አቁም ንግግሮችን እንደሚያደናቅፍ በመግለጽ ኮንኗል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yaman humnoota Huutii waliin walii galtee uumuu diduun, nagaa waaraa kan biyyattii irratti humna waraanaa tokko qofa taasisu barbaaduu isaa ibseera. Iiraaq gama isheetin, qilleensa fi lafa ishee kanneen biroo irratti waraana gaggeessuuf itti fayyadamuu akka hin danda'amne akeekkachiifteetti. Gareen ogeeyyii iccitii Ameerikaa doorsisa Iiraan irraa Donald Trump irratti qajeele jedhamee dubbatame kan amanamu miti jedhaniiru. Gama biraatiin, gareen Haamaas haleellaa xiyyaaraa Israa'el gaaza irratti raawwatte, yaalii nagaa buusuu irratti gufuu guddaa ta'uu isaa ibsee balaaleffateera.

title: Pakistan says Israel's refusal to withdraw forces from Gaza 'serious setback' to peace plan
english: Pakistan has formally criticized Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for rejecting the creation of a Palestinian state and refusing to pull troops out of Gaza. The Pakistani Foreign Ministry emphasized that Palestinian statehood is supported by international law and UN mandates, regardless of Israel's current stance. Officials in Islamabad warned that Israel’s decision to maintain a military presence in Gaza undermines previously agreed-upon peace commitments.
amharic: ፓኪስታን የፍልስጤም መንግሥት እንዲመሰረት አለመቀበሉን እና ከጋዛ ወታደሮቹን ለማስወጣት ፈቃደኛ አለመሆኑን በመቃወም የእስራኤሉን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ አውግዛለች። የፓኪስታን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር እንዳስታወቀው፣ የእስራኤል አቋም ምንም ይሁን ምን የፍልስጤም መንግሥትነት በዓለም አቀፍ ሕግ እና በተባበሩት መንግሥታት ውሳኔዎች የተረጋገጠ ነው። ኢስላማባድ አክላም እስራኤል ወታደሮቿን ከጋዛ ላለማስወጣት የወሰደችው ውሳኔ ቀደም ሲል የገቡትን የሰላም ስምምነቶች የሚጥስ እና ለሰላም ሂደት ትልቅ እንቅፋት መሆኑን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Paakistaan ministira muummee Israa'el Binyamiin Neetaanyaahuu mootummaa Falasxiin uumuuf diduu fi waraana ishee gaazaatii baasuu diduu ishee cimsitee balaaleffatteetti. Ministeerri dhimmi alaa Paakistaan akka jedhutti, mootummaan Falasxiin seera idil-addunyaa fi murtee gamtaa mootummoota gamtoomaniin kan deggerame ta'uu isaa ibseera. Bulchiinsi Islaamaabaad akka ibsetti, Israa'el gaazaa keessaa waraana ishee baasuu diduun ishee walii galtee nagaa duraan irra ga'ame kan cabsuu fi carraaqqii nagaa irratti gufuu guddaa akka ta'e akeekkachiisteetti.

title: Israeli troops set on fire, bombed homes in south Lebanon
english: Early on Thursday, Israeli military forces conducted bombings and burned residential houses in southern Lebanese towns, including Majdal Zoun and Mansouri. These military actions have persisted even as discussions regarding a potential peace deal remain ongoing. The attacks continue to impact civilian infrastructure in the region despite international efforts to reach a ceasefire.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በለባኖን ደቡባዊ ክፍሎች በሚገኙ ማጅዳል ዞን እና ማንሱሪ ከተሞች የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በቦምብ ድብደባ የቤት ንብረቶችን አውድመዋል እንዲሁም አቃጥለዋል። ምንም እንኳን የሰላም ንግግሮች እየተደረጉ ቢሆንም የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች ግን አሁንም እንደቀጠሉ ነው። ይህ ድርጊት በክልሉ የሚገኙ ሲቪል የመኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰ ይገኛል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa ganama, waraanni Israa'el magaalonni kibba Libaanoos kanneen akka Majdal Zoon fi Mansuurii keessatti haleellaa boombii gaggeessuun manneen jiraattotaa gubaniiru. Haasaawwan nagaa ta’aa jiranis, waraanni Israa'el haleellaa isaa itti fufuu isaa gabaasni ni mul'isa. Haleellaan kun qabeenyaa fi jireenya nagaa naannichaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa itti fufeera.

title: The US is now using the ‘terrorist’ label to interfere in Brazil’s election
english: The United States recently labeled Brazil's two largest criminal groups, the PCC and CV, as terrorist organizations. Critics argue this move is politically motivated rather than based on security needs, as these groups primarily seek criminal profit rather than political change. By applying this label, the US is accused of interfering in Brazilian internal politics and empowering the country’s far-right factions.
amharic: አሜሪካ በብራዚል ትልቁን ወንጀለኛ ቡድኖች የሆኑትን ፒሲሲ እና ሲቪን እንደ አሸባሪ ድርጅቶች ሰይማለች። ተቺዎች እንደሚሉት ይህ ውሳኔ የፀጥታ ጉዳይን ከመፍታት ይልቅ የብራዚልን የውስጥ ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ለመግባት እና ለቀኝ ዘመም ፖለቲከኞች ድጋፍ ለመስጠት የታለመ ነው። እነዚህ ቡድኖች በዋናነት ለወንጀል ትርፍ እንጂ ለፖለቲካዊ ለውጥ የሚሰሩ ስላልሆኑ፣ የአሜሪካ ድርጊት አጠያያቂ ሆኗል።
oromo: Ameerikaan gareewwan yakka gurguddoo biyyattii lamanii, PCC fi CV, jechuun moggaasuun 'shororkeessitoota' jedhee labsiteetti. Qeeqtonni akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun nageenya eeguurra darbee, dhimma keessoo biyyaa fi siyaasaa Biraazil keessa gadi seenuuf kan karoorfamee fi garee mirga-olaantummaa (far-right) deggeruuf kan gargaaru dha. Gareewwan kun kan hundeeffaman bu'aa yakkaatiif malee kaayyoo siyaasaatiif waan hin taaneef, labsiin kun faayidaa siyaasaa qofaaf kan taasifame jedhamee qeeqama.

title: Will the Houthis shut down Saudi Arabian shipping?
english: There are growing international concerns regarding the potential for renewed conflict in Yemen, which could threaten maritime security in the region. Analysts are questioning whether Houthi forces might attempt to disrupt Saudi Arabian shipping lanes as regional tensions escalate. This situation highlights the ongoing instability in the Middle East and the complex security challenges facing major global trade routes.
amharic: በየመን ሊቀሰቀስ ስለሚችለው አዲስ ግጭት እና ይህ ሁኔታ በአካባቢው የባህር ትራንስፖርት ላይ ሊያሳድር ስለሚችለው ተጽዕኖ አለም አቀፍ ስጋቶች እያደጉ ነው። እየጨመረ በመጣው የክልሉ ውጥረት ሳቢያ፣ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሳውዲ አረቢያን የንግድ መርከቦች ጉዞ ለማስተጓጎል ይሞክሩ ይሆን የሚለው ጥያቄ በባለሙያዎች እየተነሳ ነው። ይህ ሁኔታ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው አለመረጋጋት እና ለአለም አቀፍ የንግድ መስመሮች የተጋረጠውን የጸጥታ ስጋት ያሳያል።
oromo: Yemen keessatti waraanni deebi'ee ka'uu danda'uufi kun immoo nageenya karaa galaanaarratti dhiibbaa uumuu danda'u irratti yaaddoon idil-addunyaa dabalaa jira. Walitti bu'iinsi naannichaa hammaachaa waan jiruuf, gareen Huutii karaa dooniiwwan Sa'udii Arabaa ittiin darban cufuuf yaaluu danda'a jedhanii ogeeyyiin gaaffii kaasuutti jiru. Haalli kun nageenya dhabuu Baha Giddu-galeessaa fi balaa karaaleen daldala addunyaa qaban kan mul'isu dha.

title: Polls open in Zambia presidential election as economic reforms tested
english: Zambians are heading to the polls to decide if President Hakainde Hichilema deserves a second term as the country deals with significant economic struggles. While the current administration highlights its recent reforms and infrastructure projects, many voters remain concerned about the high cost of living. The election features 13 candidates, with former minister Brian Mundubile emerging as the main opposition figure challenging Hichilema’s leadership.
amharic: የዛምቢያ ህዝብ ፕሬዝዳንት ሃካይንድ ሂቺሌማ በስልጣን ላይ እንዲቆዩ ወይም ለውጥ እንዲያመጡ ድምጻቸውን እየሰጡ ይገኛሉ። የሂቺሌማ መንግስት ያደረገውን የኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያ ለስኬት ቢጠቅስም፣ አብዛኛው ህዝብ ግን በኑሮ ውድነት መማረሩን ገልጿል። በምርጫው 13 እጩዎች የሚወዳደሩ ሲሆን፣ የቀድሞ ሚኒስትር ብሪያን ሙንዱቢሌ የፕሬዝዳንቱ ዋና ተፎካካሪ በመሆን እየተወዳደሩ ነው።
oromo: Ummanni Zambiyaa prezedantii Haakayinde Hichileema yeroo lammaffaaf muuduu fi dhiisuu isaanii irratti sagalee kennuuf gara mana filannootti ba'aa jiru. Mootummaan ammaa hojii misoomaa fi jijjiirama dinagdee hojjechaa jiraachuu ibsus, lammiileen baay'een gatiin jireenyaa olka'uu isaan yaaddessee jira. Filannoo kana irratti dorgomtoonni 13 kan hirmaatan yoo ta'u, ministeerri duraanii Biraayin Mundubilee mormituu ijoo ta'uun prezedanticha quunnameera.

title: Nearly 4 million Afghan children ‘acutely malnourished’
english: A new report from Save the Children reveals that nearly 4 million Afghan children under five are suffering from acute malnutrition. This crisis is worsening because humanitarian funding has dropped significantly, leading to the closure of hundreds of essential health clinics. As aid continues to decline, children are losing access to the life-saving support they need to survive.
amharic: ሴቭ ዘ ችልድረን የተባለው ድርጅት ባወጣው አዲስ መረጃ መሰረት በአፍጋኒስታን በአምስት ዓመት ዕድሜ ክልል ውስጥ የሚገኙ ወደ አራት ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ህጻናት ለከፍተኛ የተመጣጠነ ምግብ እጥረት ተጋልጠዋል። ይህ ችግር የተባባሰው የሰብአዊ እርዳታ በመቀነሱ ምክንያት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ የጤና ተቋማት በመዘጋታቸው ነው። የገንዘብ ድጋፉ እየቀነሰ በመሄዱ ህጻናት ለህልውናቸው አስፈላጊ የሆነውን የጤና አገልግሎት ማግኘት ተቸግረዋል።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraan ‘Save the Children’ baase akka agarsiisutti, ijoolleen Afgaanistaan keessa jiraatan miliyoona 4 ta’an kan umriin isaanii waggaa shan gadi ta’e dhibee waa'ee nyaata hir'uutiin miidhamaa jiru. Rakkoon kun kan hammaate gargaarsi namoomaa waan hir'ateef dhaabbileen fayyaa hedduun cufamuu isaaniitiin dha. Deeggarsi maallaqaa yeroo ammaa xiqqachaa waan deemeef, ijoolleen tajaajila fayyaa lubbuu isaanii baraaruu danda'u argachuu irratti rakkoo guddaa keessa jiru.

title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
english: Nobel Peace Prize laureate Dmitry Muratov stated that Vladimir Putin has lost the ability to achieve victory in the Ukraine conflict. Muratov highlighted that Russia has intensified its crackdown on free speech, resulting in the silencing of independent outlets like his newspaper, Novaya Gazeta. He further warned that thousands of citizens are being imprisoned for opposing state policies, reflecting a level of suppression that exceeds the intensity seen during the Soviet era.
amharic: የኖቤል የሰላም ሽልማት አሸናፊው ዲሚትሪ ሙራቶቭ፣ ቭላድሚር ፑቲን በዩክሬን ጦርነት ድል የመቀዳጀት ዕድል እንደሌላቸው ተናግረዋል። ሙራቶቭ እንደገለጹት፣ በሩሲያ ውስጥ የመናገር ነፃነት ላይ እየተደረገ ያለው ጫና ተባብሶ የእሳቸው ጋዜጣ የሆነችውን ኖቫያ ጋዜታን ጨምሮ በርካታ ነፃ ሚዲያዎች እንዲዘጉ ተደርጓል። በሀገሪቱ የሰላማዊ ፖሊሲን በመቃወማቸው ብቻ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች መታሰራቸውን የገለጹት ሙራቶቭ፣ ይህ የጭቆና መጠን የቀድሞው የሶቪየት ዘመንን የባሰ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Badhaasa Nobeliin kan badhaafaman Dimitrii Muraatov, Putiin waraana Yukreen keessatti injifannoo argachuu akka hin dandeenye ibsaniiru. Muraatov akka jedhanitti, Raashiyaan mirga yaada ibsachuu irratti ukkaamsaa cimaa gochuun, gaazexaan isaanii 'Novaayaa Gaazeetaa' dabalatee miidiyaaleen walaba ta'an akka cufaman ta'eera. Namoonni kumaan lakkaa'aman siyaasa mootummaa mormuu isaaniitiin hidhamuu isaanii kan eeran Muraatov, ukkaamsaan kun yeroo Sooviyeet durii caalaa kan hamaate ta'uu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Russian strike sparks fire at Ukraine port; Zelenskyy seeks interceptors
english: Russian forces recently attacked a key grain port in Izmail, leading to a significant fire and infrastructure damage. Amidst these intensified strikes, President Zelenskyy is urgently requesting that the United States provide a small percentage of its Patriot missile supply to bolster Ukraine's failing defense systems. Ukraine is currently struggling to intercept rapid ballistic missiles and warns that these shortages will endanger many lives throughout the winter.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በቅርቡ በኢዝማይል ወደብ ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት ከፍተኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎና የንብረት ውድመት አስከትለዋል። በዚህ የጥቃት ውጥረት ውስጥ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪዩዩ ዩክሬን እያጋጠማት ያለውን የአየር መከላከያ ክፍተት ለመሙላት አሜሪካ ከሚገኘው የፓትሪዮት ሚሳይል ክምችት ጥቂት በመቶ እንድትሸጥላቸው በአስቸኳይ እየጠየቁ ነው። ዩክሬን ፈጣን የባላስቲክ ሚሳይሎችን መከላከል ተስኗት በመቆየቷ፣ ይህ የአቅርቦት እጥረት በክረምቱ ወቅት የብዙ ሰዎችን ህይወት አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa dhiheenya kana buufata doonii Izmaayil irratti haleellaa raawwataniin ibidda guddaa fi miidhaa qabeenyaa geessiseera. Haleellaa kana hordofee, Pireezidaanti Zelenskii guutuu biyyattii keessatti meeshaalee ittisa xiyyaaraa (Patriot) dhabamuurraa kan ka'e, Ameerikaan qabeenya ishee keessaa harka xinnoo akka isaan gurgurtu hatattamaan gaafataniiru. Yeroo ammaa Yukreen xiyyaara waraanaa saffisaa (ballistic missiles) ittisuu waan dadhabdeef, hanqinni kun gannaa dhufu kana lubbuu namoota hedduu balaaf saaxiluu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: Why tariffs are not the right tool to bolster US production
english: Donald Trump is heavily relying on tariffs to try and strengthen the United States economy and increase domestic production. However, many economists are skeptical about this approach and doubt that these trade barriers will achieve the intended results. Despite his focus on this strategy, experts suggest that tariffs may not be the most effective way to improve the country's manufacturing output.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስን ኢኮኖሚ ለማጠናከር እና የአገር ውስጥ ምርትን ለመጨመር በታሪፍ ወይም በንግድ ቀረጥ ላይ በእጅጉ ይተማመናሉ። ሆኖም፣ ብዙ ኢኮኖሚስቶች ይህ ስልት ውጤታማ እንደሆነ ጥርጣሬ አላቸው። በታሪፍ አማካኝነት የሚደረገው ግፊት አገሪቱ የምትፈልገውን የኢንዱስትሪ ዕድገት ለማምጣት ትክክለኛው መፍትሔ ላይሆን እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Donald Trump dinagdee Yuunaytid Isteetis cimsuufi oomisha biyya keessaa dabaluuf gibira gurguddaa (tariffs) fayyadamaa jira. Haa ta'u malee, ogeeyyiin diinagdee hedduun tarsiimoon kun bu'aa gaarii akka hin qabneefi kaayyoo barbaadame akka hin galmaannee shakkii qabu. Gibirri gurguddaa kun oomishummaa biyyattii fooyyessuuf mala sirrii ta'uu akka hin dandeenye hayyoonni ni ibsu.

title: Leavitt to leave as White House press secretary
english: Karoline Leavitt, the youngest person to serve as White House press secretary, has declared she will resign from her post by the end of this month. She stated that her decision to leave the role is motivated by a desire to prioritize her family. Her departure marks the end of her notable tenure in this high-profile position.
amharic: የዋይት ሀውስ የፕሬስ ጸሐፊ በመሆን ያገለገለችው ካሮሊን ሊቪት ከወሩ መጨረሻ ጀምሮ ከኃላፊነቷ እንደምትለቅ አስታውቃለች። ሊቪት የዋይት ሀውስ የፕሬስ ጸሐፊ በመሆን ያገለገለች በጣም ወጣቷ ግለሰብ ነች። ከሥራዋ የምትለቀውም ጊዜዋን ለቤተሰቧ ለመስጠት እንደሆነ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Hoggantuun dubbi himtuu waajjira mana mootummaa (White House) kan taate Karoliin Liiviit, dhuma ji’a kanaa irratti hojii ishee gadhiisuuf murteessiteetti. Liiviit dubbi himtuu mana mootummaa taatee kan hojjette umuriin ishee xiqqa ta’uun kan beekamtudha. Murtoon hojii gadhiisuu ishee kunis maatii isheetiif xiyyeeffannaa kennuuf akka ta’e ibsiteetti.

title: Three Palestinian families besieged in their homes by Israeli settlers
english: Three Palestinian families in the West Bank village of Qusra are currently trapped in their homes due to a blockade by Israeli settlers. The settlers have cut off essential services including water and electricity while preventing the families from leaving. Although the Israeli military recently cleared a nearby outpost, the settlers quickly returned to continue the siege.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ መንደር የሚገኙ ሦስት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች በእስራኤል ሰፈራተኞች ታግተው ይገኛሉ። ሰፈራተኞቹ ቤተሰቦቹ ከቤታቸው እንዳይወጡ ከመከልከላቸውም በላይ የውሃ እና የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎቶችን አቋርጠውባቸዋል። የእስራኤል ጦር በአካባቢው የነበረውን ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈር ቢያፈርስም፣ ሰፈራተኞቹ ወዲያውኑ በመመለስ ጥቃቱን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Maatiin Palastaayinii sadii baadiyyaa Qusraa kan West Bank keessatti argaman, uummata Israa'el biyya sana irraa buqqa'anii dhufaniin manneen isaanii keessatti ugguramanii jiru. Namoonni kunneen bishaanifi humna ibsaa irraa kutuun maatiin kun akka hin baane godhaniiru. Waraanni Israa'el buufata isaanitti dhihoo jiru tokko yoo diiges, namoonni kunneen yeroodhuma sana deebi'uun marfannaa isaanii itti fufaniiru.

title: Search efforts in Colombia enter ‘final phase’ as quake toll reaches 265
english: Rescue teams in Colombia are moving into the final stage of search operations following a powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake that has claimed at least 265 lives. With nearly 500 people still missing, crews are working urgently as the critical 72-hour survival window closes. President de La Espriella has declared an economic emergency and pledged to create a recovery fund to rebuild vital infrastructure like schools and hospitals.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ የተከሰተውን የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ተከትሎ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች ወደ መጨረሻ ምዕራፍ ተሸጋግረዋል። እስካሁን ባለው መረጃ መሰረት 265 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው ያለፈ ሲሆን፣ ወደ 500 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ደግሞ የደረሱበት አልታወቀም። ፕሬዝዳንት ደ ላ ኤስፕሪዬላ የድንገተኛ ጊዜ አዋጅ በማወጅ የወደሙ ትምህርት ቤቶችን እና ሆስፒታሎችን እንደገና ለመገንባት የሚያስችል ፈንድ እንደሚመሰርቱ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa keessatti kirkirri lafaa cimaan 7.4 ga’u erga mudatee booda, hojiin barbaacha fi furmaata fayyaa gara sadarkaa xumuraatti ce’eera. Hanga ammaa namootni 265 lubbuun isaanii yoo darbu, namootni 500 ol ta’an immoo eessa akka jiran hin beekamu. Pirezidaantiin biyyattii hatattamaan labsiin diinagdee akka labsamu gochuun, manneen barnootaa fi hospitaala diigaman deebisanii ijaaruuf gargaarsa akka godhan waadaa galaniiru.

title: Israeli settlers besiege Palestinian families in West Bank’s Qusra
english: Israeli settlers have surrounded three Palestinian families in the West Bank village of Qusra, cutting off their access to electricity, water, and essential supplies. The affected residents are refusing to leave their homes, fearing that abandoning their property will allow the settlers to seize their land permanently. Although military forces have been present in the area, the families report that they have not received sufficient protection, leaving them in a desperate situation as their resources dwindle.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ መንደር የሚገኙ የኢስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች ሦስት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦችን በመክበብ የኤሌክትሪክ፣ የውኃ እና የምግብ አቅርቦታቸውን ቆርጠዋል። ቤተሰቦቹ ቤታቸውን ለቀው ቢወጡ መሬታቸው በሰፈራ ሰሪዎቹ እንደሚወሰድ በመስጋት በጽናት ቤት ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል። የኢስራኤል ወታደሮች በአካባቢው ቢኖሩም ለተጎጂዎቹ አስፈላጊውን ጥበቃ አላደረጉም ሲሉ ነዋሪዎቹ ቅሬታቸውን ገልጸዋል፤ በዚህም ምክንያት ቤተሰቦቹ በከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Buqqaattoonni Israa'el ganda Qusraa kan West Bank keessatti argamu keessatti maatiiwwan Falasxiin sadii marsuun bishaan, ibsaa fi meeshaalee barbaachisoo ta'an irraa addaan kutaniiru. Maatiiwwan kun lafti isaanii akka hin fudhatamneef manaa isaanii gadhiisuuf kan hin fedhine yoo ta'u, jireenya rakkisaa keessatti argamu. Humnoonni waraanaa Israa'el naannichatti argamanis gargaarsa gahaa akka hin taasiisneefi isaan dhiisanii akka jiran maatiiwwan kun himaniiru.

title: Solar eclipse carves Eiffel Tower’s silhouette in Paris sky
english: A partial solar eclipse was visible over Paris, creating a striking scene as it appeared behind the Eiffel Tower. While the event was only partially visible in France and other European regions, it appeared as a total eclipse in parts of Iceland, Greenland, and Spain. This rare astronomical display drew attention across the continent.
amharic: በፓሪስ ሰማይ ላይ ከፊል የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ የታየ ሲሆን፣ ክስተቱም ታዋቂው የኢፍል ታወር ጀርባ ላይ አስደናቂ ትዕይንት ፈጥሮ ነበር። ይህ ግርዶሽ በፈረንሳይ እና በአውሮፓ ክፍሎች ከፊል ሆኖ ሲታይ፣ በግሪንላንድ፣ በአይስላንድ እና በስፔን ግን ሙሉ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ ሆኖ ታይቷል። ያልተለመደው ይህ የሰማይ ክስተት የአህጉሪቱን ትኩረት ስቧል።
oromo: Guyyaa kaleessa magaalaa Paariis keessatti aduun hir'attee mul'achuun ishee, ijaarsa 'Eiffel Tower' duubatti haala ajaa'ibsiisaa ta'een akka mul'attu taasiseera. Guyyaan aduu kun Faransaayii fi biyyoota Awurooppaa kaan keessatti hir'atee kan mul'ate yoo ta'u, biyyoota akka Ayislaandi, Giriinlaandii fi Ispeen keessatti garuu guututti aduun akka haguugamtu ta'eera. Kunuu taatee samii adda ta'e kan namoonni hedduun itti gammadan ture.

title: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
english: The WHO director-general has warned that the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could become the deadliest in history, potentially surpassing the 2014-2016 crisis. Since its official recognition in May, the rare Bundibugyo strain has spread rapidly because it was initially misdiagnosed and is complicated by regional instability. Researchers are currently working on developing and testing new vaccines to address this specific strain, as there are currently no approved treatments available.
amharic: የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት ዋና ዳይሬክተር በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እየተከሰተ ያለው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ እ.ኤ.አ ከ2014-2016 ከነበረው የከፋ እና በታሪክ ገዳዩ ሊሆን እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። በግንቦት ወር በይፋ የታወጀው ይህ ያልተለመደ የኢቦላ ዝርያ በመጀመሪያ እንደ ወባ ወይም ታይፎይድ በመሳሳቱ እና በአካባቢው ባለ የጸጥታ ችግር ምክንያት በፍጥነት ተስፋፍቷል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ሳይንቲስቶች ይህንን የኢቦላ ዝርያ ለመከላከል የሚረዱ ክትባቶችን በማዘጋጀት ላይ ሲሆኑ፣ እስካሁን ድረስ ለዚህ ዝርያ የተረጋገጠ የሕክምና አማራጭ የለም።
oromo: Hogganaan Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaa (WHO) dhibee Ebola amma RD Kongo keessatti hammaachaa jiru kun, kan waggaa 2014-2016 caalaa kan lubbuu namaa baay'ee galaafatu ta'uu akka danda'u akeekkachiiseera. Dhibeen kun jalqaba irratti akka busaa ykn dhukkuba garaatti waan shakkameef ariitiidhaan babal'achuu danda'eera, akkasumas naannichatti rakkoon tasgabbii dhabuu to'annoo isaa irratti gufuu ta'eera. Ammaaf dhukkubicha kana ittisuuf tallaalliin adda addaa qorannoo irratti kan argaman yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti garuu qorichi dhibee kanaaf mirkanaa'e hin jiru.

title: Three men will be executed on the same day as death penalties rise in US
english: For the first time in 16 years, three prisoners are set to be executed in the United States on the same day. This event reflects a broader trend of increasing capital punishment across the country following President Trump's recent executive actions to reinstate and expedite federal executions. While support for the death penalty varies among the public, the current administration is actively facilitating state and federal efforts to carry out these sentences more frequently.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ለ16 ዓመታት ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ሁኔታ በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ ሶስት እስረኞች በሞት እንዲቀጡ ተወስኗል። ይህ ክስተት ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የሞት ቅጣትን እንደገና ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ እና ለማፋጠን የወሰዱትን እርምጃ ተከትሎ በሀገሪቱ የሞት ቅጣት አፈፃፀም እየጨመረ መምጣቱን ያሳያል። ምንም እንኳን የህዝብ አስተያየት የተለያየ ቢሆንም፣ አሁን ያለው መንግስት በየግዛቱ እና በፌደራል ደረጃ የሞት ቅጣቶች በስፋት እንዲከናወኑ እየሰራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ameerikaatti waggaa 16 keessatti yeroo jalqabaatiif hidhamtoonni sadan guyyaa tokkotti akka ajjeefaman murtaa'eera. Kunis tarkaanfii Preezidaant Traamp adaba du'aa deebisanii hojiirra oolchuufi saffisiisuuf fudhatan booda, adabni du'aa biyyattii keessatti dabalaa akka jiru argisiisa. Yaanni uummataa gara garuu ta'us, mootummaan amma jiru mootummoota naannoofi federaalaa keessatti adaba kana raawwachuuf gargaarsa taasisaa jira.

title: Olympic skateboarder times epic stunt with solar eclipse
english: Spanish Olympic skateboarder Danny León successfully executed a unique skateboarding trick at the exact moment of a solar eclipse. He recorded the impressive maneuver and posted it on social media, describing it as the greatest stunt of his career. This rare synchronization of athletic skill and a celestial event has captured significant attention.
amharic: ስፓኒሽ ኦሊምፒክ የስኬትቦርድ ተጫዋች ዳኒ ሊዮን የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ በተከሰተበት ወቅት አስደናቂ የሆነ የስኬትቦርድ ትርኢት አሳይቷል። አትሌቱ ይህን ድንቅ እንቅስቃሴውን በመቅረጽ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ያጋራ ሲሆን፣ ይኸውም የህይወቱ ምርጥ ስራ እንደሆነ ገልጿል። ይህ ያልተለመደ የክህሎት እና የተፈጥሮ ክስተት ጥምረት በብዙዎች ዘንድ አድናቆትን አትርፏል።
oromo: Atileetiin iskeetbordii Oolompiikii kan Ispeen, Daanii Le'oon, yeroo aduun haguugamte (solar eclipse) sanatti gochaa dinqisiisaa tokko raawwateera. Le'oon tarkaanfii isaa kana viidiyoon qabatee miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti kan gadhiise yoo ta'u, gocha kana jireenya isaatii keessatti kan isa boonsuufi adda ta'e akka ta'e dubbateera. Gochi atileetichaa kun ogummaa isaa fi mudannoo uumamaa kana walitti fiduun isaa xiyyeeffannoo hedduu harkiseera.

title: Zimbabwe’s land reform enters a new chapter
english: The Zimbabwean government has initiated a new land policy that addresses long-standing disputes following the controversial land reforms that began in 2000. Under this plan, the state will return specific properties to foreign investors, correct previous errors by restoring land to Black Zimbabwean owners, and allow some white farmers to purchase their land through a compensation-linked process. Officials emphasize that this move is intended to resolve outstanding legal and investment obligations rather than reversing the original land redistribution goals.
amharic: የዚምባቡዌ መንግስት ከ2000 ዓ.ም በኋላ በተካሄደው አከራካሪ የመሬት ማሻሻያ ዙሪያ የቆዩ ክርክሮችን ለመፍታት አዲስ የመሬት ፖሊሲ ተግባራዊ ማድረግ ጀምሯል። በዚህ እቅድ መሰረት መንግስት የተወሰኑ መሬቶችን ለውጭ ባለሀብቶች የሚመልስ ሲሆን፣ በስህተት የተወሰዱ መሬቶችን ለባለቤቶቹ በመመለስ እና አንዳንድ ነጭ አርሶ አደሮች የመሬት ይዞታቸውን በካሳ ስርዓት እንዲገዙ በመፍቀድ ጉዳዮችን እያስተካከለ ነው። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት ይህ እርምጃ የቀድሞውን የመሬት ክፍፍል ግብ የሚቀለብስ ሳይሆን፣ ህጋዊ እና የኢንቨስትመንት ግዴታዎችን ለመወጣት ያለመ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Zimbaabuwee jijjiirama lafaa bara 2000 eegalee kaasee ture irratti wal-dhabdee jiru furuuf imaammata lafaa haaraa hojiirra oolchaa jira. Karoora kanaan, mootummaan lafa qabeenya biyyoota alaa ta'e deebisuu, dogoggora kanaan dura ture sirreessuun lafa abbootii qabeenyaa gurraachotaaf deebisuu, akkasumas qonnaan bultoota adii tokko tokkoof lafa isaanii kafaltii kaffaluun akka bitatan hayyamuuf ka'eera. Hojjettoonni mootummaa akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun qoodinsa lafaa duraanii kan diigu utuu hin taane, dirqama seeraa fi invastimantii mootummaan qabu xumuruuf kan yaadamedha.

title: Half a tonne of Erling Haaland branded cocaine seized in Ecuador
english: Ecuadorian police discovered nearly 500 kilograms of cocaine hidden inside a truck near the Colombian border. The drug bricks were uniquely marked with the name and photograph of professional footballer Erling Haaland. Authorities arrested a Colombian woman in connection with the significant drug seizure.
amharic: የኢኳዶር ፖሊስ ከኮሎምቢያ ድንበር አቅራቢያ በጭነት መኪና ውስጥ ተደብቆ የተገኘ ወደ 500 ኪሎ ግራም የሚጠጋ ኮኬይን መያዙን አስታውቋል። በአደንዛዥ እጾቹ ላይ የእግር ኳስ ተጫዋቹ ኤርሊንግ ሃላንድ ስም እና ምስል ታትሞባቸው ተገኝቷል። ከዚህ ግኝት ጋር በተያያዘ የኮሎምቢያዊት ሴት በቁጥጥር ስር ውላለች።
oromo: Poolisiin Ekwadoor daangaa Kolombiyaa biratti konkolaataachaa keessa dhokfamee argame kookayinii kiiloogiraama 500 ga'u qabate. Kookayinii kana irratti maqaan fi suuraan taphataa kubbaa miilaa Erling Haalaand maxxanfamee argameera. Poolisiin dhimma kana irratti dubartii lammii Kolombiyaa taate tokko to'annoo jala oolcheera.

title: Iran war live: US, Tehran exchange opposing claims over Hormuz control
english: Tensions between the United States and Iran have intensified over the strategic Strait of Hormuz. President Trump claims that the U.S. maintains complete control of the waterway, while Iranian officials remain defiant, insisting that the passage will stay closed until their specific demands are addressed. Meanwhile, shipping activity in the area has reached its lowest point in a week due to the ongoing conflict.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት በስትራቴጂካዊው የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ምክንያት እየተባባሰ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በባህረ ሰላጤው ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዳላት ቢገልጹም፣ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ግን ጥያቄዎቻቸው እስኪሟሉ ድረስ መተላለፊያው ተዘግቶ እንደሚቆይ በማስጠንቀቅ አቋማቸው ላይ ጸንተዋል። በግጭቱ ምክንያት በቦታው ያለው የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ በአንድ ሳምንት ውስጥ ዝቅተኛው ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Waliigalteen Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduu jiru hammaachuu isaa hordofee, to'annoo daandii galaana Hormuz irratti wal-dhabiirri uumamee jira. Preezidaant Traamp Ameerikaan guutummaatti daandii kana to'achaa akka jirtu kan himan yoo ta'u, Iraan gamasheen garuu hanga gaaffiin isaanii deebii argatutti daandichi cufaa akka ta'u dhaadattee jirti. Waraana kana irraa kan ka'e, sochiin dooniiwwan daldalaa naannichatti torban tokko keessa gara sadarkaa isa gadi aanaatti gadi bu'ee jira.

title: Vultures are disappearing in Nigeria - but the 'Vulture King' is fighting to reverse the trend
english: Vulture populations across West Africa are plummeting due to hunting and traditional beliefs, putting ecosystems at risk of disease. In the Nigerian town of Awka-Etiti, a man known as the Vulture King is working to protect these birds by leveraging local spiritual traditions. Because residents view vultures as sacred messengers that signify the acceptance of religious sacrifices, the birds are safe from harm within the community's protected forest.
amharic: በምዕራብ አፍሪካ የሚገኙ የጥንብ አንሳ ዝርያዎች በአደን እና በተለያዩ እምነቶች ምክንያት ከመጥፋት አፋፍ ላይ ደርሰዋል፣ ይህም የተፈጥሮ ስነ-ምህዳርን ለአደጋ እየዳረገ ነው። በናይጄሪያ አውካ-ኢቲቲ ከተማ የሚኖሩ 'የጥንብ አንሳ ንጉስ' በመባል የሚታወቁ ሰው፣ የአካባቢውን ባህላዊ እምነት በመጠቀም እነዚህን ወፎች ለመታደግ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ። በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ጥንብ አንሳዎች የተቀደሱ እና የመሥዋዕት ተቀባይነትን የሚያሳዩ እንደሆኑ ስለሚታመን፣ በከተማዋ ጥብቅ ደን ውስጥ በሰላም እንዲኖሩ ተደርጓል።
oromo: Afrikaa Lixaatti, adamoo fi amantiiwwan aadaa irraa kan ka'e baay'inni allaattiiwwan 'vulture' jedhamanii waamaman daran gadi bu'aa jiraachuun isaa naannoo keenya dhukkubaaf saaxilaa jira. Magaalaan Naayijeeriyaa Awka-Etiti jedhamtu keessatti, namni 'Mootii Vulture' jedhamu tokko aadaa fi amantii naannichaa fayyadamuun allaattiiwwan kunneen akka hin banne ittisaa jira. Jiraattonni naannichaa allaattiiwwan kunniin hafuuraa fi fudhatama aarsaa kan agarsiisan jedhanii waan amannaniif, bosona qulqulluu magaallattii keessatti nageenyi isaanii eegameera.

title: Trump administration arrests Southern Poverty Law Center expert for fraud
english: Federal authorities have arrested Heidi Beirich, a former top official at the Southern Poverty Law Center, on charges of wire fraud and money laundering. The Trump administration alleges that she misused donor contributions to pay off leaders of extremist groups instead of fighting them as promised. Beirich and her legal team maintain that the accusations are false and politically motivated, arguing that the investigation targets the nonprofit for its work against right-wing organizations.
amharic: የፌዴራል ባለስልጣናት የደቡባዊ ድህነት ህግ ማእከል (SPLC) የቀድሞ ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን የሆኑትን ሃይዲ ቤይሪች በገንዘብ ማጭበርበር እና በህገ-ወጥ የገንዘብ ዝውውር ክስ በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ተከሳሡ ለጋሾችን በማታለል የተሰበሰበውን ገንዘብ ጽንፈኛ ቡድኖችን ለመዋጋት ከመጠቀም ይልቅ ለቡድኖቹ መሪዎች በምስጢር ክፍያ መፈጸማቸውን ይገልጻል። የቤይሪች ጠበቆች ግን ክሱ መሰረተ ቢስ እና በፖለቲካዊ አላማ የተፈጠረ ነው በማለት የድርጅቱን ስራ ለማዳከም የሚደረግ ዘመቻ እንደሆነ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoota federaalaa kan ta'an Heidi Beirich, kan duraan dhaabbata Southern Poverty Law Center (SPLC) keessatti hojjechaa turan, yakka malaammaltummaa fi qarshii seeraan alaa qabuuf to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Mootummaan Trump akka himatutti, namtichi kun qarshii arjooltotaa irraa walitti qabame, garee humnoota ol-aantummaa sanyii babal'isan to'achuuf ooluu qabu ture, garuu iccitidhaan hoogganoota garee kanniiniif kaffaluuf itti fayyadameera jedhu. Beirich fi gosti seeraa ishee gama biraatiin, himannaan kun dhugaa kan hin qabne fi kaayyoo siyaasaa qofa kan qabu jechuun, dhaabbatichi hojii isaa kan sirrii irratti xiyyeeffate waan ta'eef akka miidhamu gochaa jiru jedhu.

title: Media groups sue Trump over paid access to public social media posts
english: Several media advocacy groups have sued President Donald Trump to stop his company from charging high subscription fees for early access to his social media posts. The lawsuit argues that selling exclusive, real-time information violates the First Amendment and limits the public's right to access government announcements equally. Critics claim this system is corrupt because it allows the president to personally profit from information that significantly impacts the global economy.
amharic: በርካታ የሚዲያ ድርጅቶች ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ለሚያወጡት መረጃ ቀድሞ ለመድረስ ከፍተኛ ክፍያ መጠየቃቸውን በመቃወም ክስ መስርተዋል። ይህ የክፍያ ስርዓት የመረጃ እኩልነትን እንደሚጥስ እና በህገ መንግስቱ የተረጋገጠውን የመረጃ ነፃነት እንደሚፃረር አቤቱታው ይገልፃል። ተቺዎች ይህ ድርጊት ፕሬዝዳንቱ በአገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ተፅዕኖ በሚያሳድሩ መረጃዎች የግል ጥቅም ለማግኘት የሚሞክሩበት ሙሰኛ አካሄድ ነው ሲሉ ይከሳሉ።
oromo: Dhaabbileen miidiyaa gurguddoon tokko tokko, Preezidaant Doonaald tiraampii fi dhaabbanni isaa miidiyaa hawaasummaa isaanii irratti odeeffannoo argachuuf kaffaltii guddaa gaafachuu isaanii mormuun seeraan himatanii jiru. Himannaan kun akka jedhutti, odeeffannoo hatattamaa ta'e maallaqaan gurguruun mirga hawaasni odeeffannoo walqixa argachuuf qabu kan miidhuu fi mirga dubbii bilisaa kan cabsuudha. Gadaa isaaniitti, tarkaanfiin kun preezidaantichi odeeffannoo gabaa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisu fayyadamuun fayidaa dhuunfaa argachuuf yaaluu isaa kan agarsiisuu fi malaammaltummaa guddaa akka qabu himatameera.

title: Trump administration plans to give ICE officers electric-shock gloves
english: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security intends to spend up to $20 million to provide immigration agents with specialized gloves that deliver electric shocks. Officials claim these devices are intended to help agents de-escalate difficult situations, but rights advocates are concerned about potential misuse against immigrants and protesters. This decision follows ongoing criticism regarding the use of excessive force and aggressive tactics by ICE personnel.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሀገር ውስጥ ደህንነት መምሪያ ለኢሚግሬሽን ወኪሎች የኤሌክትሪክ ንዝረት የሚሰጡ ልዩ ጓንቶችን ለመግዛት እስከ 20 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ሊያወጣ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናት መሳሪያዎቹ አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታዎችን ለመቆጣጠር ይረዳሉ ቢሉም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ግን በስደተኞች እና በተቃዋሚዎች ላይ አላግባብ ጥቅም ላይ ይውላሉ የሚል ስጋት አላቸው። ይህ እርምጃ በICE ሰራተኞች ላይ የሚሰነዘረውን የኃይል አጠቃቀም ትችት ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Manni Maree Nageenya Biyoolessaa Ameerikaa jila godhattoota godaantotaa fi baqattootaa to'atuuf gilaavii elektirikii gadhiisan bituuf hanga miiliyoona 20 doolaaraa baasuuf karoorfateera. Mootummaan meeshaaleen kun rakkoo uumame tasgabbeessuuf gargaaru jedheera; garuu mirga namoomaa falmitoonni godaantota irratti miidhaan akka hin geenye yaaddoo qabu. Murteen kun tarkaanfii jabaa fi humna darbe ICE fudhachaa jiru irratti qeeqni guddaan erga ka'ee booda kan dhufe dha.

title: Why are 'human fridges' being sold in Japan?
english: Japan is experiencing record-breaking summer temperatures that have led to tens of thousands of heatstroke cases and nearly 80 deaths. In response, a new cooling device called the Do Hiemon, or 'Cooling Box,' has been introduced for public and commercial use. Inspired by freezer vending machines, these specialized units are designed to help people escape the extreme heat.
amharic: ጃፓን እጅግ በጣም ከፍተኛ የሆነ የሙቀት መጠን እያጋጠማት ሲሆን ይህም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ለህመም እና ለሞት ዳርጓል። ለዚህ ችግር መፍትሄ ይሆን ዘንድ 'የማቀዝቀዣ ሳጥን' በመባል የሚታወቀው አዲስ መሳሪያ በህዝብ ቦታዎች እና በንግድ ድርጅቶች ውስጥ አገልግሎት ላይ ውሏል። መሳሪያው ከማቀዝቀዣ ማሽኖች በተገኘ ሀሳብ የተፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ ሰዎች ከከፍተኛ ሙቀት እራሳቸውን እንዲከላከሉ ታስቦ የተዘጋጀ ነው።
oromo: Jaappaan keessatti ho’i baay’ee ol ka’uun isaa namoota kumaatama hedduu irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee jira. Haala kana dandamachuuf, meeshaan 'Saanduqa qabbaneessaa' jedhamu kan gabaa irratti dhiyaate yoo ta’u, kunis iddoowwan ummataa fi bakka hojiitti itti fayyadamuuf gargaara. Meeshaan kun kan uumame yaadannoo maashiniiwwan qabbaneessoo irraa ka’uun yoo ta’u, kaayyoon isaas namoota ho’a cimaa irraa hambisuu dha.

title: US strikes in Yemen killed 153 civilians in 2025, says Pentagon review
english: A recent Pentagon report reveals that United States military operations in Yemen caused 153 civilian deaths and 243 injuries during 2025. These casualties all occurred across three specific strikes conducted in April, with the attack on the Ras Isa fuel port being the most destructive. While US officials stated the missions were intended to disrupt Houthi funding and resources, the assessment confirmed that these operations resulted in significant unintended loss of life.
amharic: የፔንታጎን አዲስ ዘገባ እንደሚያሳየው እ.ኤ.አ. በ2025 በየመን በተካሄዱ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች 153 ንጹሃን ዜጎች ሲሞቱ ሌሎች 243 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። እነዚህ ጉዳቶች በሙሉ በኤፕሪል ወር በተፈጸሙ ሶስት ጥቃቶች የደረሱ ሲሆን፣ በተለይም በራስ ኢሳ የነዳጅ ማዕከል ላይ የተደረገው ጥቃት ከፍተኛው የሰው ህይወት ተቀጥፏል። አሜሪካ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመችው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎችን የገቢ ምንጭ ለማስተጓጎል እንደሆነ ብትገልጽም፣ ምርመራው ግን ድርጊቱ ያልታሰበ ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እንዳስከተለ አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Gabaasni Pentagooni dhiheenya bahe akka ibsetti, bara 2025 keessa haleellaa waraana Ameerikaan Yemen keessatti gaggeeffameen namoonni nagaa 153 lubbuun darbuu fi 243 ammoo madaa'uu beekameera. Miidhaan kun hundi haleellaa baatii Epreel keessa bakka sadiitti gaggeeffame keessatti kan uumame yoo ta'u, haleellaa buufata boba'aa Raas Isaa irratti raawwatame keessatti miidhaan guddaan geessifameera. Mootummaan Ameerikaa haleellaa kana kan raawwate aanga'oota Houtii kan maallaqa irraa argatan ittisuuf ta'us, qorannoon Pentagooni garuu haleellaan kun namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa mirkaneesseera.

title: Hegseth cautions that ICC may investigate US boat strikes in Latin America
english: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has warned that the International Criminal Court might investigate American military operations targeting drug boats in Latin America. While the US claims these strikes against cartels are legal, human rights organizations argue they constitute extrajudicial killings that have caused many civilian casualties. In response, Hegseth is urging regional allies to reject the court's authority as part of a broader Trump administration effort to challenge the tribunal.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴዝ፣ ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት በላቲን አሜሪካ በሚካሄዱ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ የባህር ላይ ጥቃቶች ላይ ምርመራ ሊያካሂድ እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። አሜሪካ በኮንትሮባንድ ነጋዴዎች ላይ የምትወስዳቸው እርምጃዎች ህጋዊ ናቸው ብትልም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ግን ጥቃቶቹ የብዙ ንፁሃን ህይወት የቀጠፉ ህገ-ወጥ ግድያዎች መሆናቸውን ይከራከራሉ። የሄግሴዝ አስተዳደር አጋር ሀገራት የፍርድ ቤቱን ስልጣን እንዲቃወሙ ግፊት እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Ameerikaa Pete Hegseth, Manni Murtii Yakka Addunyaa duula waraana Ameerikaa kan lafa garba Laatiin Ameerikaatti godhamu irratti qorannoo geggeessuu akka malu akeekkachiisaniiru. Ameerikaan tarkaanfii garee sammattu qoricha sammuu irratti fudhattu seera qabeessa ta'uu ibsituus, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa garuu tarkaanfichi ajjeechaa seeraan alaa ta'uu fi lubbuu namoota nagaa hedduu galaafachuu isaa himu. Hegseth mootummoota naannichaa biraa fi harka caalu irraa kanneen duula kana deggeran, aangoo mana murtichaa akka hin beekneef dhiibbaa gochaa jiru.

title: PSG win back-to-back UEFA Super Cups with victory over Aston Villa
english: Paris Saint-Germain successfully defended their UEFA Super Cup title by defeating Aston Villa 2-1 in Salzburg. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and Desire Doue scored for the French side, while 17-year-old Brian Madjo netted a historic debut goal for Villa. This victory marks PSG's second consecutive Super Cup win, a feat not achieved by any club since Real Madrid in 2017.
amharic: ፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርሜን አስቶን ቪላን 2 ለ 1 በማሸነፍ የUEFA ሱፐር ካፕ ዋንጫን በድጋሚ ማሳካት ችለዋል። ለፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርሜን ድል መገኘት ክቪቻ ክቫራትስኬሊያ እና ዴዚሬ ዱዌ ግቦቹን ያስቆጠሩ ሲሆን፣ ለቪላ የ17 ዓመቱ ብሪያን ማጆ በታሪክ የመጀመሪያ የውድድር ጨዋታው ግብ ማስቆጠር ችሏል። ይህ ድል ፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርሜን ከ2017 ወዲህ በውድድሩ ተከታታይ ሁለት ዋንጫዎችን ያነሳ የመጀመሪያው ክለብ እንዲሆን አስችሎታል።
oromo: Pariis Saint-Jarmeen Aston Viilaa 2-1 injifachuun waancaa UEFA Super Cup yeroo lammaffaaf walitti aansee fudhateera. Pariis Saint-Jarmeeniif Kviichaa Kvaaratskeliyaa fi Deziiree Duwee goolii lakkoofsiseera, yeroo Viilaaf dargaggeessi waggaa 17 Brian Maajo tapha isaa jalqabaa irratti goolii seena qabeessa galcheera. Injifannoon kun Pariis Saint-Jarmeen akka Real Maadrid bara 2017 booda waancaa kana walitti aansee fudhate tokkoffaa akka ta'u isa taasiseera.

title: Thousands missing after Colombia quake as rescue continues
english: A massive 7.4-magnitude earthquake recently struck western Colombia, resulting in hundreds of deaths and leaving thousands of people unaccounted for. Rescue crews are currently working through the debris of destroyed buildings to find survivors. However, relief operations are facing significant challenges due to broken communication lines and a shortage of medical resources in hospitals.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ የተከሰተው የ7.4 ማግኒትዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ደግሞ የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በፈራረሱ ህንጻዎች ስር የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ የቴሌኮሙኒኬሽን መቋረጥ እና የህክምና ቁሳቁስ እጥረት የነፍስ አድን ስራውን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Biyya Kolombiyaa kutaa dhihaa keessatti sochii lafaa cimaa hamma 7.4 ta'een namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman lubbuun darbanii, kumni dhibbaan lakkaa'amammmoo eessa akka jiran hin beekamu. Ogeessonni fayyadamtootaa fi gargaartonni namoota caccabaa manaa jala jiran barbaaduuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Ta'us, rakkoon quunnamtii fi hanqinni qoricha fi meeshaalee fayyaa hojii gargaarsaa sana ulfaataa godheera.

title: Morocco says working to prevent potential new Ceuta crossings surge
english: Moroccan authorities have strengthened security along the borders of the Spanish exclaves Ceuta and Melilla to prevent unauthorized migration. This move follows the spread of social media rumors falsely claiming the border would be opened for mass crossings on August 15. The government is also taking legal action against those who incite illegal entry or spread disinformation online.
amharic: የሞሮኮ ባለስልጣናት ወደ ስፔን ግዛት Ceuta እና Melilla ድንበሮች የሚደረጉ ህገ-ወጥ የሰዎች ፍልሰቶችን ለመከላከል የጸጥታ ጥበቃን አጠናክረዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በነሐሴ 15 ቀን ድንበሩ ለጅምላ መሻገሪያ ክፍት እንደሚሆን በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ የተሰራጨውን የሀሰት ወሬ ተከትሎ ነው። መንግስት ህገ-ወጥ መሻገሪያዎችን የሚያበረታቱ ወይም የሀሰት መረጃዎችን የሚያሰራጩ አካላት ላይ ህጋዊ እርምጃ እየወሰደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Marookoo daangaa biyyattii gara magaalaalee Ispeen kan ta'an Ceuta fi Melilla irra jiru eegumsa isaa cimseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga miidiyaa hawaasaarratti oollee kanaan dura guyyaa Hagayya 15 daangaan ni banama jedhee sobaan babal'ate boodadha. Mootummaan namoota yaalii godaansaa seeraan alaa kakaasan ykn odeeffannoo sobaa babal'isanirratti tarkaanfii seeraa fudhachaa jira.

title: 11-year-old boy shot by Israeli forces in Gaza
english: An 11-year-old boy in Khan Younis, Gaza, has been shot in the head and leg by Israeli military forces, according to his father. This incident is part of a broader surge in violence that has resulted in over 1,200 Palestinian deaths and thousands of injuries since last October. The ongoing conflict continues to cause severe casualties and humanitarian distress across the region.
amharic: በጋዛ ካን ዩኒስ የሚኖር የ11 ዓመት ህጻን በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ጭንቅላቱ እና እግሩ ላይ በጥይት መመታቱን የአካባቢው ምንጮች እና የህጻኑ አባት አስታውቀዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት ካለፈው ጥቅምት ወር ጀምሮ በእስራኤል እና ፍልስጤም መካከል በተቀሰቀሰው ግጭት ከ1,200 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን ከተገደሉባቸው እና በሺዎች ከሚቆጠሩት ጥቃቶች አንዱ ነው። ቀጣይነት ያለው ግጭት በክልሉ ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እና ሰብአዊ ቀውስ እያስከተለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gaza, magaalaa Khan Younis keessatti ijoolleen waggaa 11 tokko rasaasa waraana Israa'eliin mataa fi miilla irraa miidhamuu isaa abbaan isaa ibseera. Miidhaan kun kan hordofe waraana ji'a Onkoloolessa darbe irraa kaasee itti fufeen lubbuun namoota Falasxiin 1,200 ol darbee fi kumaan kan lakkaa'aman ammoo madaa'anii jiru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun naannichatti lubbuu namoota baay'ee galaafachuu fi miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa itti fufeera.

title: Drone attacks on energy infrastructure deepen Libya’s energy crisis
english: Libya is facing a severe energy crisis due to recurring drone strikes targeting its oil and power facilities. These attacks have disrupted fuel distribution and increased the frequency of blackouts across the country. The situation is further aggravated by ongoing conflicts between rival factions vying for control over the city of Az Zawiya.
amharic: ሊቢያ በነዳጅ እና በኤሌክትሪክ መሰረተ ልማቶቿ ላይ በሚሰነዘሩ ተደጋጋሚ የድሮን ጥቃቶች የከፋ የሃይል ቀውስ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የነዳጅ አቅርቦትን በማስተጓጎል በሀገሪቱ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ እንዲባባስ አድርገዋል። የአዝዛዊያን ከተማን ለመቆጣጠር በሚፎካከሩ ቡድኖች መካከል ያለው ግጭትም ችግሩን ይበልጥ አወሳስቦታል።
oromo: Liibiya bu'uuraalee misoomaa kanneen akka boba'aa fi elektirikii irratti miidhaa ga'aa jiruun rakkoo humna elektirikii hamaa keessa seentee jirti. Haleellaan xiyyaara maleeyyuun kun dhiyeessii boba'aa waan gufuu ta'eef, guutummaa biyyattiitti hir'inni ibsaa dabaluu isaati. Wal dorgommii gareelee magaalaa Az Zawiya to'achuuf wal irratti godhanis rakkoo kana caalaatti hammaachiisee jira.

title: Israeli air strike kills one in northern Gaza
english: An Israeli airstrike in northern Gaza killed a municipal worker and injured five others while they were traveling in a vehicle after performing maintenance work. The Israeli military stated the attack aimed to neutralize a Hamas commander, marking a return to aerial bombardment after a brief period of reduced activity. These incidents occurred amidst ongoing regional tension and the rejection of a recent U.S.-led peace proposal.
amharic: በሰሜናዊ ጋዛ በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት አንድ የከተማ አስተዳደር ሰራተኛ ሲገደል አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ሰራተኞቹ የውሃ ጉድጓድ ጥገና አድርገው በመመለስ ላይ እያሉ ሲሆን፣ እስራኤልም ኢላማው የሃማስ አዛዥ እንደነበር አስታውቃለች። ይህ ጥቃት የአሜሪካ የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ ከተደረገ በኋላ እና ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ቀንሶ የነበረው የአየር ላይ ጥቃት እንደገና በመቀጠሉ በአካባቢው ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gama kaaba Gaazaatti qilleensa irraa haleellaa gaggeesseen hojjetaan tajaajila magaalummaa tokko yommuu du'u, shanan immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame hojjettoonni kun hojii suphaa boolla bishaanii booda osoo deebi'aa jiranii ta'uun ibsameera; Israa'el gama isheetiin haleellaan kun ajaja humna Hamaas irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture jetteetti. Haleellaan kun kan dhufe erga karoorri nagaa Ameerikaan dhiyeessite didamee fi haleellaan qilleensa irraa yeroo gabaabaaf dhaabbatee ture erga deebi'ee booda.

title: Lebanon passes sweeping amnesty law for prisoners, wanted people
english: The Lebanese parliament has approved a major amnesty law for the first time since 1991 to help address severe prison overcrowding and long trial delays. This new legislation will reduce sentences and pardon thousands of individuals, including those who have been waiting in jail for years. The decision follows years of political debate and gained new momentum following the recent political changes in neighboring Syria.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ፓርላማ ከ1991 ወዲህ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በወህኒ ቤቶች ውስጥ ያለውን መጨናነቅ ለመቀነስ እና ረጅም የፍርድ ሂደት በመጠበቅ ላይ ያሉ እስረኞችን ለመርዳት የሚያስችል አጠቃላይ የምህረት አዋጅ አጽድቋል። ይህ አዲስ ህግ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ እስረኞችን የሚጠቅም ሲሆን፣ የቅጣት ጊዜያቸውን የሚቀንስ ወይም ነጻ የሚያስለቅቅ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ለዓመታት ሲነሱ የነበሩ የፖለቲካ ጥያቄዎችን ለመመለስ እና በሶሪያ ውስጥ የተከሰተውን የፖለቲካ ለውጥ ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Mana mareen biyya Libaanon erga bara 1991 asitti yeroo jalqabaaf labsiin dhiifama waliigalaa mana hidhaa keessatti walitti dhufeenya uumame hir’isuuf gargaaru raggaasiseera. Labsiin kun hidhamtoota bara dheeraaf murtiishee eeggataa turaniifi namoota barbaadamaa turan kumaatamaatti fayyadama.
