Murteen kun waggoota dheeraaf falmii siyaasaa erga turee booda, jijjiirama siyaasaa biyya Suuriyaa keessatti dhiheenya kana mudate hordofuun kan ragga’e dha.

title: Israel vows to keep troops in Lebanon, Gaza and Syria
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz has declared that the nation will maintain its military presence in Gaza, Lebanon, and Syria. He emphasized that there are no plans to withdraw troops from these security zones under any circumstances. This announcement follows a previously proposed agreement that was intended to pull Israeli forces out of the southern region of Lebanon.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ ሀገራቸው በጋዛ፣ በሊባኖስ እና በሶሪያ ያሰማራችውን ወታደራዊ ኃይል እንደማታስወጣ አስታውቀዋል። በማንኛውም ሁኔታ ከእነዚህ የጸጥታ ቀጠናዎች ወታደሮቻቸውን ለማስወጣት ምንም አይነት እቅድ እንደሌላቸውም አሳስበዋል። ይህ መግለጫ ቀደም ሲል ከደቡብ ሊባኖስ ወታደሮችን ለማስወጣት የተደረገውን ስምምነት ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Raayyaa Ittisa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz, biyyattii waraana ishee Gaaza, Libaanoos fi Sooriyaa keessa jiru akka hin baafne ibsaniiru. Haala kamiinuu bakkeewwan nageenyaa kana keessaa waraana ishee baasuuf karoora akka hin qabne mirkaneessaniiru. Labsiin kunis kanaan dura waraana Israa'el kibba Libaanoos keessaa baasuuf waliigaltee irra ga'amee ture booda kan dhufe dha.

title: Photos: Solar eclipse plunges parts of Europe into darkness
english: Millions of people across Europe and other regions recently witnessed a total solar eclipse for the first time in 27 years. The moon completely blocked the sun, creating several minutes of darkness for those living along the path of totality, which included Iceland, Russia, Greenland, Spain, and Portugal. Additionally, many other areas across the globe were able to observe a partial eclipse during the event.
amharic: ሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ የአውሮፓ እና ሌሎች አካባቢዎች ነዋሪዎች ከ27 ዓመታት በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ሙሉ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽን ተመልክተዋል። ጨረቃ ሙሉ በሙሉ ፀሐይን በመሸፈኗ በአይስላንድ፣ በሩሲያ፣ በግሪንላንድ፣ በስፔን እና በፖርቱጋል መስመር ላይ የነበሩ ሰዎች ለተወሰኑ ደቂቃዎች በድንገተኛ ጨለማ ውስጥ እንዲያሳልፉ አድርጋለች። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም በዓለም ዙሪያ የሚገኙ ሌሎች በርካታ አካባቢዎች የፀሐይ ግርዶሹን በከፊል ማየት ችለዋል።
oromo: Miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman uummata Awurooppaa fi naannoowwan biroo keessa jiraatan waggaa 27 booda yeroo jalqatiif ifa aduu guutummaatti haguugame arganiiru. Jiini aduu guutummaatti haguuguun isaa, naannoowwan akka Aayislaandi, Raashiyaa, Giriinlaandi, Ispeenii fi Poorchugaal keessa turan daqiiqoota muraasaaf dukkana keessa akka turan taasiseera. Kana malees, addunyaa irratti bakkeewwan biroo hedduun ifa aduu kana hir’atee ykn hir’inaan arguu danda’aniiru.

title: ‘Platformicide’ of Palestine: Activists struggle to be heard on Meta
english: A new report highlights a trend of digital suppression where pro-Palestinian activists are facing account suspensions and reduced visibility on Meta platforms like Instagram. Journalists and activists report that their content is being shadow-banned, making it difficult for their accounts to reach their followers during the ongoing conflict. Despite raising these concerns directly with Meta, users claim the company has failed to address these issues or provide a clear explanation for the widespread silencing.
amharic: አዲስ ሪፖርት እንደሚያሳየው በሜታ ማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መድረኮች ላይ የፍልስጤም ደጋፊዎች አካውንታቸው በመታገድ እና ተደራሽነታቸው በመቀነስ ላይ ይገኛሉ። ጋዜጠኞች እና አክቲቪስቶች የይዘታቸው ተደራሽነት ሆን ተብሎ እየተገደበ እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ ይህም በግጭቱ ወቅት ሃሳባቸውን ለህዝብ እንዳያደርሱ አድርጓቸዋል። እነዚህን ቅሬታዎች በቀጥታ ለሜታ ቢያቀርቡም ኩባንያው ችግሩን ለመፍታት ፈቃደኛ አለመሆኑን ተጠቃሚዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: gabaasni haaraa tokko akka agarsiisutti, deggertoonni Falasxiin miidiyaa hawaasaa Meta (Instagram fi Facebook) irratti akkayyantii isaanii dhorkamuu fi mul'achuu dhabuu rakkina guddaa keessa jiru. Gaazexeessitootnii fi falmitootni oduu fi odeeffannoo isaanii namoota bira akka hin geenyeef meeshaaleen teeknoolojii kun ictiin (shadow-banning) fayyadamuun akka isaan ukkaamsan himatu. Gabaasni kun rakkina kana Meta biratti kaasuun isaanis, hanga ammaatti kampaniin kun deebii quubsaa kennuu fi jijjiirama fiduu akka hin dandeenye ibsameera.

title: Trump reveals Karoline Leavitt to step down as White House press secretary
english: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt is stepping down from her position at the end of the month to focus on her family following the birth of her second child. President Donald Trump praised her past performance and confirmed she will transition into an advisory role for his administration and the Republican Party. Her departure is part of a broader trend of leadership changes occurring within the current Trump administration.
amharic: የዋይት ሀውስ ፕሬስ ሴክሬታሪ ካሮሊን ሌቪት ሁለተኛ ልጃቸውን በመውለዳቸው ከቤተሰባቸው ጋር ጊዜ ለማሳለፍ ሲሉ በወሩ መጨረሻ ከስልጣናቸው እንደሚለቁ ተገለጸ። ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ያከናወኑትን ስራ በማመስገን፣ ለወደፊቱም በአስተዳደራቸው እና በሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ውስጥ አማካሪ ሆነው እንደሚቀጥሉ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በትራምፕ አስተዳደር ውስጥ እየተካሄደ ካለው የከፍተኛ አመራር ለውጦች አንዱ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan miidiyaa mana mootummaa (White House) Karoliin Leeviit, mucaa isaanii isa lammaffaa erga deessanii booda maatii isaanii wajjin yeroo dabarsuuf jecha xumura ji'a kanaatti hojii isaanii gadhiisuuf jiru. Preezidaant Donaald Traamp hojii isaanii dinqisiifatanii, gara fuulduraattis gorsaa ta'anii mootummaa isaanii fi paartii Riippubliikaan keessatti akka tajaajilan ibsaniiru. Gadhifannaan kun jijjiirama hoogganoota mootummaa Traamp keessatti yeroo ammaa mul'achaa jiru keessaa isa tokko.

title: Josh Kushner, Bob Iger, buying Los Angeles Lakers for record $12.5bn
english: Venture capitalist Josh Kushner and former Disney executive Bob Iger are acquiring the Los Angeles Lakers in a historic deal valued at $12.5 billion. They are purchasing the team from billionaire Mark Walter, who is currently facing federal investigations regarding his business dealings. The transaction is still awaiting final approval from the NBA Board of Governors.
amharic: የኢንቨስትመንት ባለሙያው ጆሽ ኩሽነር እና የቀድሞው የዲስኒ ስራ አስፈፃሚ ቦብ ኢገር የሎስ አንጀለስ ሌከርስ ቅርጫት ኳስ ቡድንን በሪከርድ በሆነ 12.5 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ለመግዛት ተስማምተዋል። ቡድኑን እየሸጡ ያሉት ቢሊየነሩ ማርክ ዋልተር በንግድ ስራቸው ላይ በፌዴራል ምርመራ እየተደረገባቸው ነው። የዚህ የሽያጭ ስምምነት ይፋዊ እንዲሆን የኤንቢኤ ቦርድ ማፅደቅ ይጠበቅበታል።
oromo: Abbaan qabeenyaa Josh Kushner fi qindeessaan duraanii Walt Disney Bob Iger garee kubbaa basketii Los Angeles Lakers qarshii biliyoona 12.5n bituuf walii galan. Garee kana kan gurgurataa jiru biliyooneera Mark Walter yoo ta'u, inni immoo qorannoo federaalaa irratti banamee jira. Walii galteen kun raggaasifamuuf hayyama boordii NBA eeggachaa jira.

title: Israeli forces detain three people in West Bank
english: Israeli military forces arrested ten Palestinians during multiple operations throughout the occupied West Bank on Wednesday. Three individuals were taken into custody near the town of Beit Ummar, while seven others were apprehended in various locations including Jenin, Ramallah, and Tulkarm. Among those detained was a journalist and several former prisoners.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ረቡዕ ዕለት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ባደረጉት ተከታታይ ዘመቻዎች አስር ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ከእነዚህ መካከል ሦስቱ በቤት ኡማር አካባቢ ሲያዙ ቀሪዎቹ ሰባቱ በጀኒን፣ በራምላ እና በቱልካርም በተካሄዱ ወረራዎች ተይዘዋል። በቁጥጥር ስር ከዋሉት መካከል አንድ ጋዜጠኛ እና የቀድሞ እስረኞች ይገኙበታል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el guyyaa Roobii guutuu kutaalee Daangaa Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti hojiiwwan sakatta'iinsaatiin namoota Falasxiin kudhan to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Namootni sadii magaalaa Beit Ummar cinaatti qabaman yoo ta'u, torban biroo immoo naannolee Jenin, Ramallah fi Tulkarm keessatti qabamaniiru. Namoota to'annoo jala oolanii keessa gabaasaa oduu tokko fi namoota kanaan dura hidhamanii turan hedduutu argamu.

title: Iran says no progress on reviving interim peace deal with US
english: Iran and the United States have failed to make any headway in reviving their June interim peace agreement. Tensions remain high as both nations continue to blame each other for the collapse of the deal, which was intended to stop military operations in the Gulf. Despite efforts by mediators to establish a new timeline for the agreement, the situation remains stalled amid ongoing regional instability.
amharic: ኢራን እና አሜሪካ በሰኔ ወር የተደረሰውን ጊዜያዊ የሰላም ስምምነት ለማደስ የሚያደርጉት ጥረት ምንም አይነት ለውጥ አላሳየም። በባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ የነበረውን ግጭት ለማስቆም የተደረገው ስምምነት በመፍረሱ ሁለቱ ሀገራት አሁንም አለመግባባት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። አስታራቂዎች ስምምነቱን ለማስቀጠል ጥረት ቢያደርጉም እስካሁን ምንም አይነት መሻሻል አልታየም።
oromo: Iraanii fi Ameerikaan walii galtee nagaa yeroo gabaabaa ji'a Waxabajjii keessa turan sana haaromsuuf carraaqqii godhan irratti jijjiirama tokkollee hin fiduu danda'an. Waliigalteen kun waraana naannoo galaana sanaa dhaabsisuuf kan karoorfame ta'us, hamma ammaatti hojiirra ooluu hin dandeenye. Giddungaaltonni walii galtee kana deebisanii jalqabsiisuuf yaalii godhanis, hamma ammaatti jijjiiramni mul'ate tokkollee hin jiru.

title: Trump says White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt to leave post
english: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt is stepping down from her role at the end of the month to focus on raising her two young children. President Trump praised her service, noting that she will transition into a role as one of his top outside advisors. Leavitt, who was the youngest person to hold the press secretary position, stated that she chose to prioritize her family life over the intense demands of her public office.
amharic: የዋይት ሀውስ የፕሬስ ሴክሬታሪ ካሮላይን ሌቪት ከሁለት ትናንሽ ልጆቿ ጋር ጊዜ ለማሳለፍ ሲሉ በወሩ መጨረሻ ከስልጣናቸው እንደሚለቁ አስታውቀዋል። ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ለነበራቸው አገልግሎት ምስጋናቸውን በመግለጽ፣ ወደፊትም ዋና የውጭ አማካሪዎቻቸው አንዷ እንደሚሆኑ ገልጸዋል። በታሪክ ትንሿ የፕሬስ ሴክሬታሪ የነበሩት ሌቪት፣ ይህን ውሳኔ የወሰኑት ለቤተሰባቸው ቅድሚያ በመስጠት መሆኑን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Itti gaafatamaan qondaala oduu mana maree mootummaa (White House) Karoliin Leeviit, ijoollee ishee lamaan waliin yeroo dabarsuuf jechuudhaan dhuma baatii kanaa irratti hojii ishee gadi dhiisuuf jirti. Pireezidaanti Traamp tajaajila ishee kan galateeffatan yoo ta'u, gara fuulduraattis gorsituu isaanii taatee akka itti fuftu ibsaniiru. Namni umuriin ishee xiqqaa ta'ee bakka kana qabattee turte kun, murtee kana kan dabarsite hojii cimaa fi jireenya maatii ishee gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa uumame furuuf ta'uu ibsiteetti.

title: Iceland and Spain plunged into darkness during total solar eclipse
english: A rare total solar eclipse recently cast Iceland and Spain into darkness as thousands of spectators gathered to witness the event. This marks the first time in 27 years that Europe has experienced such a phenomenon. The eclipse followed a path of totality approximately 300 kilometers wide across the region.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተከሰተው ሙሉ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ ምክንያት አይስላንድ እና ስፔን በጨለማ ተውጠው ነበር፤ በርካታ ተመልካቾችም ይህንን አስደናቂ ክስተት በአካል ተገኝተው ተመልክተዋል። ይህ ክስተት አውሮፓ በ27 ዓመታት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ያጋጠማት ነው። ግርዶሹ በክልሉ ውስጥ በግምት 300 ኪሎ ሜትር ስፋት ባለው መስመር ላይ ታይቷል።
oromo: Guyyaa muraasa dura, haguugamuun aduu guutuu biyyoota Aayislaandii fi Ispeen keessatti mudachuun, namoota hedduu biratti akkaataa dinqisiisaa ta'een ilaallameera. Taateen kun waggoota 27 keessatti kan jalqabaa yommuu ta'u, sa'aatii muraasaaf lafti dukkana keessa turteetti. Haguugamuun kun karaa bal'ina kiilomeetira 300 qabuun naannichatti mul'ateera.

title: Palestinian students and staff sue Columbia University over discrimination
english: A group of Palestinian students and staff members have filed a lawsuit against Columbia University, claiming they were subjected to discrimination and unfair treatment. The plaintiffs allege that the university unfairly targeted pro-Palestinian activists and created a hostile environment following the events of October 7. The legal complaint argues that the institution actively participated in the harassment of individuals based on their ethnic and political backgrounds.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ተማሪዎች እና የዩኒቨርሲቲው ሰራተኞች በኮሎምቢያ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ላይ ክስ መስርተዋል። አመልካቾቹ ዩኒቨርሲቲው ከጥቅምት 7ቱ ክስተት በኋላ በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ መድልዎ እንደፈጸመ እና ለፍልስጤም ድጋፍ የሚያደርጉ እንቅስቃሴዎችን እንዳጠቃ ይከሳሉ። የክስ ማመልከቻው ተቋሙ በአባላቱ ላይ ዘረኛ እና ፖለቲካዊ ተጽእኖ እንዳሳደረ ይገልጻል።
oromo: Barattoonni fi hojjettoonni Falasxinuu tokko Yuunivarsiitii Kolombiyaa irratti himata bananiiru. Himataan kunneen, yuunivarsiitichi erga mudannoo Onkoloolessa 7 gaggeeffamee as, barattootaa fi hojjettoota Falasxinuu irratti gidiruu fi loogii raawwachaa akka jiru himatu. Himatichi akka jedhutti, yuunivarsiitichi namoota yaada isaaniitiin deeggartoota Falasxinuu ta'an irratti dhiibbaa fi jibba akka uume ibsa.

title: Defence minister says Israeli military will remain in Lebanon, Syria and Gaza
english: Israel's Defense Minister Israel Katz announced that the military will not pull back from its positions in Gaza, Syria, or Lebanon. He made this declaration while visiting frontline troops stationed in southern Lebanon. The minister emphasized that maintaining this presence is a non-negotiable policy for the country.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ፣ እስራኤል በጋዛ፣ በሶሪያ እና በሊባኖስ የያዘችውን ቦታ እንደማትለቅ አስታውቀዋል። ይህንን መግለጫ የሰጡት በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የጦር ግንባር ወታደሮቻቸውን በጎበኙበት ወቅት ነው። ሚኒስትሩ ወታደራዊ መገኘታቸውን መቀጠል ለሀገራቸው እንደማይደራደሩበት ዋና ጉዳይ አድርገው ገልጸውታል።
oromo: Ministirri Ittisaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz, waraanni isaanii Gaza, Sooriyaa fi Libaanoos keessatti bakka qabatan akka hin gadi dhiisne ibsaniiru. Ibsa kana kan kennan yeroo gara kibba Libaanoositti loltoota isaanii daawwatanitti. Ministirichi humni waraanaa bakka kana turuun isaa murtoo jijjiiramu hin qabne ta'uu jala muranii dubbataniiru.

title: Pentagon tells Congress US killed 153 civilians in Yemen air strikes
english: A recent Pentagon report submitted to Congress acknowledges that US military operations in Yemen during 2025 resulted in 153 civilian deaths and 243 injuries. These airstrikes were ordered by the Trump administration in retaliation for Houthi attacks on Red Sea shipping. While the military campaign caused significant damage to Houthi infrastructure, human rights groups have raised serious concerns regarding the high civilian toll and potential war crimes.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ለኮንግረስ ባቀረበው ሪፖርት በ2025 በየመን በተካሄዱ የአየር ጥቃቶች 153 ንጹሃን ዜጎች መገደላቸውንና 243 ሰዎች መቁሰላቸውን አምኗል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በቀይ ባህር የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ ለተሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶች ምላሽ ለመስጠት ያዘዛቸው ነበሩ። ምንም እንኳን ወታደራዊ ዘመቻው በታጣቂዎቹ ላይ ጉዳት ቢያደርስም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች በንጹሃን ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳትና የጦር ወንጀል ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ ድርጊቶችን በፅኑ እየተቹ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gabaasni Pentagonii dhiheenya kana Kongiresiif dhiyaate, bara 2025 keessa Yamanitti duula waraanaa geggeeffameen namoonni nagaa 153 ajjeefamanii 243 immoo madaa'uu isaanii beeksiseera. Haleellaan kunneen kan ajajaman mootummaa Trumpitiin yoo ta'u, kanneenis gareen Huutii galaana diimaa keessatti markaboota irratti haleellaa geggeessaniif deebii kennuuf kan raawwataman turan. Duulli waraanaa kun bu'uuraalee garee Huutii irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee kan ture ta'us, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa miidhaa namoota nagaa irratti ga'ee fi yakka waraanaa ta'uu danda'u ilaalchisee yaaddoo cimaa qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Iraq says no foreign military presence by 1 Oct and weapons will be under state control
english: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Faleh al-Zaidi announced that all international military forces must depart the country by September 30. Starting October 1, the Iraqi government will take full responsibility for national security. Additionally, new regulations will ensure that all weaponry is managed exclusively by state institutions to bolster the nation's sovereignty.
amharic: የኢራቅ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አሊ ፋለህ አል-ዛይዲ ሁሉም የውጭ አገር ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በሴፕቴምበር 30 ቀን አገሪቱን ለቀው መውጣት እንዳለባቸው አስታውቀዋል። ከጥቅምት 1 ቀን ጀምሮ የኢራቅ መንግስት የራሱን የፀጥታ ጉዳዮች ሙሉ በሙሉ እንደሚቆጣጠር ገልጸዋል። እንዲሁም የአገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት ለማስከበር ሁሉም የጦር መሳሪያዎች በመንግስት ተቋማት ቁጥጥር ስር ብቻ እንደሚሆኑ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Iraaq Alii Faaleh al-Zaydi, waraanni biyya alaa hundi hanga Fulbaana 30 biyyattii gadhiisanii bahuu akka qaban beeksisaniiru. Mudde 1 irraa eegalee, mootummaan Iraaq nageenya biyyattii guututti of harkatti akka galchu ibsameera. Kana malees, aangoo mootummaa cimsuuf jecha, meeshaaleen waraanaa hundi to'annoo dhaabbilee mootummaa qofa jala akka galan murtaa'eera.

title: UK, Italy among states considered to verify Hezbollah disarmament, sources say
english: Israel and Lebanon have shortlisted Britain, Italy, Switzerland, and Indonesia to help monitor the disarmament of Hezbollah. This proposal follows US-led negotiations aimed at securing an Israeli military withdrawal from Lebanon. These nations may provide personnel or troops to inspect the disarmament process and ensure the terms of the agreement are met.
amharic: እስራኤል እና ሊባኖስ የሂዝቦላህን ትጥቅ መፍታት ለመከታተል እንግሊዝን፣ ጣሊያንን፣ ስዊዘርላንድን እና ኢንዶኔዥያን ለመምረጥ ተስማምተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው እስራኤል ከሊባኖስ የምታደርገውን ወታደራዊ መውጣት ለማረጋገጥ በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት በተደረገው ውይይት ነው። የተመረጡት ሀገራት የትጥቅ መፍታት ሂደቱን ለመቆጣጠር እና ለመፈተሽ የሚያስችል የሰው ኃይል ወይም ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ ሊሰጡ ይችላሉ።
oromo: Israa'el fi Lubaanoos meeshaa waraanaa Hizbollaah hiikkachiisuu hordofuuf biyyoota akka biyya Ingiliiz, Xaaliyaanii, Siwiizerlaandii fi Indooneeshiyaa akka filannoo qaban waliigalaniiru. Waliigalteen kun marii Ameerikaan giddu galeessa taate irratti hundaa'uun, waraanni Israa'el Lubaanoos keessaa akka ba'u gochuuf kan karoorfameedha. Biyyoonni kunneen adeemsa hiikkaa meeshaa waraanaa kana hordofuufi mirkaneessuuf ogeeyyota ykn waraana gargaarsaaf erguu danda'u.

title: US immigration officers to be equipped with gloves that deliver electric shocks
english: The US Department of Homeland Security plans to spend $20 million to provide immigration officers with specialized gloves capable of delivering electric shocks. These devices, known as GLOVEs, can emit up to 380 volts and are designed to assist officers in safely apprehending individuals. While the manufacturer claims the technology is non-injurious, officials emphasize that strict training and safety protocols will be followed.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሀገር ውስጥ ደህንነት መምሪያ የኢሚግሬሽን መኮንኖች በኤሌክትሪክ ንዝረት የሚሰጡ ልዩ ጓንቶችን እንዲጠቀሙ 20 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ለመመደብ አቅዷል። ግሎቭ (GLOVE) ተብለው የሚጠሩት እነዚህ መሳሪያዎች እስከ 380 ቮልት የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል በማመንጨት ተጠርጣሪዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር ለማዋል ያግዛሉ። አምራች ድርጅቱ መሳሪያው ጉዳት አያስከትልም ቢልም፣ ባለስልጣናት ጥብቅ የሆነ ስልጠና እና የደህንነት መመሪያዎች እንደሚከተሉ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Amerikaa damee nageenyaa keessaa biyyaa, humnootni imigreeshinii akka fayyadamanif harka-gogaa (gloves) elektirikii of keessaa qabu bituuf qarshii miliyoona 20 ramadeera. Meeshaan GLOVE jedhamu kun hamma voltii 380 ta'u maddisiisuudhaan, namoota to'annoo jala oolchuuf gargaara. Warri meesha kana oomishan miidhaa kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsanus, qajeelfamni cimaan fi leenjii gahaan akka barbaachisu mootummaan beeksisera.

title: Brazil orders Discord to suspend livestreams after teen’s death
english: Brazilian authorities have ordered Discord to stop its livestreaming services across the country after a 13-year-old girl died by suicide while being encouraged by others during a live broadcast. The government regulator stated that the platform failed to implement necessary protections to shield children from harmful, violent, and self-destructive content. Discord must keep these features suspended until they can prove that their safety measures for minors are effective and secure.
amharic: የብራዚል ባለሥልጣናት የዲስኮርድ (Discord) የቀጥታ ስርጭት አገልግሎትን በሀገሪቱ እንዲያቆም ትእዛዝ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የ13 ዓመት ታዳጊ ልጅ በሌሎች ግለሰቦች ግፊት እና ድጋፍ በራሷ ላይ ጉዳት አድርሳ ህይወቷ ካለፈ በኋላ ነው። የሀገሪቱ ተቆጣጣሪ አካል መድረኩ ታዳጊዎችን ከአደገኛ እና ከጥቃት ጋር በተያያዙ ይዘቶች ለመጠበቅ በቂ ጥንቃቄ አላደረገም በማለት ወቅሷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Biraazil erga mucayyoon waggaa 13 tokko guyyaa har'aa hiriyyoonni ishee iddoo 'live' ta'e irratti dhiibbaa irratti uumaniin of ajjeeftee booda, qophiin Discord tajaajila 'live streaming' biyyattii keessatti akka dhaabu ajajeera. Bulchiinsi biyyattii akka jedhetti, Discord ijoollee miidhaa fi of ajjeechuu irraa eeguuf qophii gahaa hin goone. Discord hamma inni nageenya ijoollee eegsisuu danda'uu isaa mirkaneessutti tajaajila kana dhaabuuf dirqameera.

title: Iraq says September 30 withdrawal deadline for US-led coalition ‘final’
english: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has confirmed that September 30 is the definitive deadline for the US-led international military coalition to conclude its mission and withdraw all personnel from Iraq. This move signifies the end of a long-standing foreign military presence dating back to 2003, transitioning the relationship toward economic and security collaboration. Both Iraqi and US officials agree that the mission to defeat ISIS has been successfully accomplished, allowing Iraqi security forces to take full control of the nation's defense.
amharic: የኢራቅ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አሊ አል-ዛይዲ በአሜሪካ የሚመራው ዓለም አቀፍ የጦር ኃይል ተልዕኮውን አጠናቆ ከኢራቅ የሚወጣበት የመጨረሻው ቀን መስከረም 20 እንደሚሆን አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከ2003 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ በሀገሪቱ የቆየውን የውጭ ጦር መገኘት የሚያበቃ ሲሆን፣ የሁለቱ ሀገራት ግንኙነት ወደ ኢኮኖሚ እና ደህንነት ትብብር የሚሸጋገርበትን አዲስ ምዕራፍ ይከፍታል። የአሜሪካ እና የኢራቅ ባለስልጣናት አይኤስን የመዋጋቱ ተልዕኮ ስኬታማ በመሆኑ የኢራቅ ጦር የሀገሪቱን ደህንነት ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲቆጣጠር መስማማታቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Muummee Ministiraa Iraaq Alii Al-Zayidii, waraanni mootummoota gamtoomaniin hoogganamu ergama isaa xumuree hanga guyyaa Fulbaana 30 irraa eegalee Iraaq gadhiisee akka bahu murteessan mirkaneessaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun qabiyyee waraana biyya alaa kan bara 2003 irraa eegalee ture kan xumuru yoo tahu, walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota lamaanii gara hariiroo diinagdee fi nageenyaatti akka cehu godha. Aangooti Iraaq fi Ameerikaa ergamni garee ISIS injifachuu milkaa'inaan raawwatamuu isaa waliigalaniiru; kunis humnoonni nageenyaa Iraaq ittisa biyyattii guutummaatti akka harka galfatan gargaara.

title: Thousands flee drought in Somalia amid sharp aid decline
english: A prolonged and severe drought in Somalia has devastated local livelihoods, forcing thousands of families to abandon their farms and livestock. The situation has been exacerbated by a significant reduction in humanitarian assistance, leaving many displaced people struggling to survive. Desperate families are now migrating toward relief centers like Baidoa in search of food and basic support.
amharic: በሶማሊያ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየው ድርቅ የብዙ ቤተሰቦችን እርሻና ከብቶች በማውደሙ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች መፈናቀላቸውን ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ የረሃብ አደጋ ተከስቷል። በአካባቢው የሚደረገው የሰብአዊ እርዳታ በከፍተኛ ደረጃ መቀነሱ ለተፈናቃዮች ህልውና አስጊ ሆኗል። ለዚህም ነው በርካታ የተጎዱ ቤተሰቦች የምግብ እና የድጋፍ ፍለጋ ወደ ባይዶአ ከተማ መሰደድ የጀመሩት።
oromo: Somaliya keessatti hongee mudateen kan irraa kan ka'e maatiin kumaatamaan lakkaawaman qonnaafi horsiisa beeyiladaa isaanii dhabanii qe'ee isaanii irraa godaananiiru. Gargaarsi namoomaa naannichatti kennamaa ture hir'achuu isaatiin walqabatee rakkoon jiraattotaa hammaachaa dhufeera. Haaluma kanaan, maatiin hundi isaanii nyaataafi gargaarsa barbaacha gara magaala Baido'aatti baqachaa jiru.

title: Paramount Skydance mulls CNN sale amid antitrust merger challenge
english: Paramount Skydance is considering selling CNN to help resolve an antitrust lawsuit filed by 12 states attempting to block its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. Legal executives are exploring this move to address concerns regarding political influence and media consolidation. Despite promises from leadership to maintain editorial independence, critics remain skeptical due to recent controversial shifts observed at CBS News.
amharic: ፓራማውንት ስካይዳንስ ከዋርነር ብሮስ ጋር ሊያደርገው ያቀደውን የ110 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ውህደት ለመከላከል በ12 ግዛቶች የቀረበውን ክስ ለመፍታት ሲ ኤን ኤን (CNN) ሊሸጥ እንደሚችል እየተወያየ ነው። ኩባንያው የዜና አውታሩን ነጻነት እንደሚጠብቅ ቢገልጽም፣ በሲቢኤስ ኒውስ ላይ የታዩ ለውጦች በብዙዎች ዘንድ ጥርጣሬን ፈጥረዋል። ይህ የሽያጭ ሃሳብ የህግ ተግዳሮቶችን ለመቀነስ እና ከውህደቱ ጋር ተያይዞ የሚነሱ የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ ስጋቶችን ለመቅረፍ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Paramount Skydance walii galtee Warner Bros. Discovery wajjin taasiisuuf karoorsite kan dolaara biiliyoona 110 baasu, himannaa seeraa mootummoota naannoo 12 irraa dhufe furuuf jecha CNN gurguruuf yaadaa jira. Hoggantoonni dhaabbatichaa bilisummaa gabaasa oduu kanaa akka eegan dubbatanis, jijjiiramoota CBS News keessatti mul'ataniin wal qabatee shakkiiwwan jiru. Yaanni gurgurtaa kanaas dhiibbaa siyaasaa fi rakkoolee seeraa walii galtee kanaa hir'isuuf kan kaayyeffatedha.

title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak set to become deadliest on record, WHO warns
english: The World Health Organization has warned that the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading rapidly and could soon become the deadliest in history. The virus is particularly difficult to contain due to regional conflict, poor infrastructure, and the fact that the specific strain currently circulating lacks an approved vaccine. Health officials fear the death toll may eventually surpass the catastrophic West African outbreak of 2014-2016 if response efforts do not improve immediately.
amharic: የዓለም የጤና ድርጅት በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እየተስፋፋ የሚገኘው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ በታሪክ እጅግ አደገኛ ሊሆን እንደሚችል አስጠነቀቀ። ግጭቶች፣ የተዳከመ መሰረተ ልማት እና ለዚህ የኢቦላ ዝርያ እስካሁን ክትባት አለመገኘቱ ወረርሽኙን ለመቆጣጠር ፈታኝ አድርጎታል። የጤና ባለሙያዎች አፋጣኝ እርምጃ ካልተወሰደ የሟቾች ቁጥር በ2014-2016 በምዕራብ አፍሪካ ከተከሰተው አስከፊ ወረርሽኝ ሊበልጥ እንደሚችል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa (WHO) dhukkubni Ibolaa Rippabliikii Dimookiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti babal'achaa jiru baay'ee hatattamaa ta'uu fi seenaa keessatti kan hunda caalu ta'uu akka danda'u akeekkachiiseera. Waraana naannichaa, bu'uuraalee misoomaa hir'uu fi vaayirasichi gosa adda ta'eef talaalliin waan hin jirreef to'achuun isaa ulfaataa ta'eera. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa tarkaanfiin hatattamaa hin fudhatamu taanaan, lubbuun darbuu mala kan jedhu kun akkaataa qorichaan ala ta'ee, sadarkaa weerara bara 2014-2016 Afrikaa Lixaa keessatti ture sana caaluu akka danda'u yaaddoo qabu ibsaniiru.

title: White House construction project to cost almost $1bn
english: The Trump administration is facing scrutiny after reports revealed plans to spend nearly $1 billion on White House construction, including a new ballroom. Officials defend the project as a necessary security measure coordinated with the Secret Service. However, critics and lawmakers are concerned that the heavy reliance on private donations could lead to conflicts of interest.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በኋይት ሀውስ ለግንባታ ስራዎች ወደ አንድ ቢሊዮን ዶላር ሊያወጣ መሆኑ መነጋገሪያ ሆኗል። አስተዳደሩ ፕሮጀክቱ ለፕሬዝዳንቱ ደህንነት ሲባል አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ የሚገልጽ ሲሆን፥ የህግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤት አባላት ግን በግል ለጋሾች የሚደረገው የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የጥቅም ግጭት ሊፈጥር ይችላል የሚል ስጋት አላቸው።
oromo: Mootummaan Trump mana mootummaa (White House) haaromsuuf doolara biliyoona tokko ga'u baasuuf karoorfachuu isaa hordofee mormiin ka'eera. Qondaaltonni mootummaa hojiin kun nageenya prezidantichaa mirkaneessuuf barbaachisaa akka ta'e dubbatanis, gargaarsi namoota dhuunfaa irraa argamu kun walitti bu'iinsa faayidaa uumuu danda'a jedhanii shakkuun ka'eera.

title: Major Russian grain export terminal hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack
english: A significant Ukrainian drone and missile attack has damaged Russian grain export facilities and a major naval base in the port city of Novorossiysk. The assault resulted in several civilian casualties and forced Russia to divert its cargo shipments to other transport routes. President Zelensky stated that Ukrainian forces are targeting Russian military infrastructure to weaken the ongoing occupation.
amharic: ዩክሬን በሩሲያ የኖቮሮሲይስክ ወደብ ላይ ባደረሰችው መጠነ ሰፊ የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃት የእህል መላኪያ ተርሚናሎች እና የባህር ኃይል ጣቢያ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በጥቃቱ በርካታ ሰዎች ለህልፈት እና ለጉዳት የተዳረጉ ሲሆን፣ ሩሲያም የእህል ጭነቷን ወደ ሌሎች መስመሮች ለመቀየር ተገዳለች። የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ጥቃቱ ሩሲያ የምታደርገውን ወታደራዊ ወረራ ለማዳከም የታለመ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ukraynan magaalatti doonii Novorosiyeesk irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee fi misayilii gaggeessiteen, bakkeewwan midhaan alatti erganii fi buufanni waraanaa Ruusiyaa miidhamaniiru. Haleellaa kanaan namoonni lubbuun darban yoo ta'u, miidhaan biroo irra ga'ee jira; kunis Ruusiyaan fe'umsa midhaanii gara karaa biraatti akka geessitu dirqisiiseera. Pirezidaantiin Ukraynaa Volodimir Zeeleniskii, haleellaan kun bu'uuraalee misooma waraanaa Ruusiyaa laaffisuuf kan yaadame ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Drought exposes Nazi-era warship wrecks beneath the Danube
english: Severe drought conditions in Europe have caused water levels in the Danube River near Serbia to drop significantly. This drop has revealed dozens of sunken warships left behind by Nazi forces during their retreat in 1944. These historical vessels, which had been hidden underwater for decades, are now visible due to the record-low water levels.
amharic: በአውሮፓ እየተከሰተ ያለው የከፋ ድርቅ በሰርቢያ አቅራቢያ የሚገኘው የዳኑብ ወንዝ ውሃ መጠን እንዲቀንስ አድርጓል። ይህ የውሃ መመናመን በ1944 ዓ.ም የናዚ ጦር እያፈገፈገ በነበረበት ወቅት ሰጥመው የነበሩ በርካታ የጦር መርከቦችን ገጽታ አጋልጧል። እነዚህ ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት በውሃ ውስጥ ተሰውረው የነበሩ ታሪካዊ መርከቦች አሁን በታየው ከፍተኛ የውሃ መጉደል ምክንያት ሊታዩ ችለዋል።
oromo: Hanga dhahataa (drought) cimaa Awurooppaa keessatti muudateen lagni Daanuub naannoo Serbiyaa keessatti dhangala'uun isaa baay'ee gad xiqqaateera. Hir'inni bishaanii kun, bara 1944 yeroo loltoonni Naazii duubatti deebi'aa turanitti markaboota lolaa bishaan keessatti liqimsaman hedduu ifa baaseera. Markaboonni seena-qabeeyyiin waggoota hedduuf bishaan jala dhokatee turan kun, gadi bu'iinsa bishaan sadarkaa seenaa irra gahe kana hordofee mul'achuu danda'aniiru.

title: Trump remarks on diminishing impact of pro-Israel groups in Congress
english: President Donald Trump recently stated that pro-Israel lobbying groups have significantly lost their traditional influence in Washington compared to two decades ago. During a media interview, he noted a major shift in political sentiment, particularly among Democrats in the House of Representatives. Recent polls confirm this trend, showing declining support for Israel within both the Democratic Party and sections of the Republican base.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርቡ እንደገለጹት እስራኤልን የሚደግፉ የሎቢ ቡድኖች ከሃያ ዓመታት በፊት የነበራቸውን ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ አጥተዋል። በአንድ ሚዲያ ቃለ መጠይቅ ላይ እንደተናገሩት፣ በተለይም በዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ ያለው የፖለቲካ አቋም ለውጥ በጣም አስገራሚ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥናቶችም ይህንን አዝማሚያ የሚያረጋግጡ ሲሆን፣ በእስራኤል ላይ ያለው የድጋፍ መጠን በሁለቱም ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ውስጥ እያሽቆለቆለ መምጣቱን ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Donald Traamp akka dubbatanitti, gareewwan Israa'el deggeran kunneen amansiisuu irratti dhiibbaa waggaa 20 dura qaban amma dhabaniiru. Gaaffii fi deebii miidiyaa irratti akka ibsanitti, jijjiiramni siyaasaa kun keessattuu miseensota paartii Dimokraatawaa gidduutti kan mul'atu ta'uu dubbataniiru. Qorannoowwan amansiisoonis deggersi Israa'eliif qaban lamaan isaaniyyuu keessattuu paartilee siyaasaa gurguddoo keessatti hir'achaa dhufuu isaanii mirkaneessu.

title: LA Lakers to be sold in record $12.5bn deal
english: The Los Angeles Lakers are set to be purchased for a record-breaking $12.5 billion. The controlling interest in the team will be acquired by Josh Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger. This agreement follows the majority stake acquisition by Mark Walter less than a year ago.
amharic: የሎስ አንጀለስ ሌከርስ የቅርጫት ኳስ ቡድን በሪከርድ በሆነ 12.5 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ሊሸጥ ነው። ቡድኑን የሚገዙት ጆሽ ኩሽነር እና የቀድሞው የዲስኒ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ቦብ አይገር ናቸው። ይህ ስምምነት የተፈረመው ማርክ ዋልተር አብላጫ ድርሻውን ከተቆጣጠረ ከአንድ ዓመት ባነሰ ጊዜ ውስጥ ነው።
oromo: gareen kubbaa darbannoo Los Angeles Lakers gatii seena qabeessa ta'e biliyoona 12.5 gurguramuuf qophaa'aa jira. Bitattoonni kunis Josh Kushner fi hojii gaggeessaan duraanii Walt Disney Bob Iger dha. Walii galteen kun Mark Walter hirmaannaa guddaa isaa erga fudhate waggaa tokko hin guunne keessatti kan raawwatame dha.

title: PSG vs Aston Villa LIVE: UEFA Super Cup 2026
english: Paris Saint-Germain and Aston Villa are competing in the 2026 UEFA Super Cup to mark the start of the European football season. The match is being held at the Salzburg Stadium in Austria. Kickoff is scheduled for 9:00 PM local time.
amharic: የፓሪስ ሴንት ዠርሜን እና የአስቶን ቪላ ቡድኖች የአውሮፓ የእግር ኳስ የውድድር ዘመን መጀመርያ በሆነው የ2026 ዩኢኤፍኤ (UEFA) ሱፐር ካፕ ላይ ይፋለማሉ። ጨዋታው በኦስትሪያ ሳልዝበርግ ስታዲየም የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ የመክፈቻው ሰዓትም ምሽት 3 ሰዓት ላይ ተወስኗል።
oromo: Pariis Saint-Jeermeen fi Astoon Viilaa jalqaba sagantaa kubbaa miillaa Awurooppaa kan ta'e, qophii 2026 UEFA Super Cup irratti walmorkatu. Taphi kun istaadiyoomii Saalzberg kan Awustiriyaa keessatti kan gaggeeffamu yoo ta'u, sa'aatiin isaas galgala sa'aatii sagal irratti kan eegalamu dha.

title: Europe prepares for first total solar eclipse in 27 years
english: Europe is getting ready for a total solar eclipse, the first one the continent has experienced in nearly three decades. A massive number of people are expected to watch the phenomenon as it moves through a path stretching from Iceland down to Spain. Researchers are utilizing specialized aircraft and observatories to document this rare astronomical event.
amharic: አውሮፓ በቅርቡ የሚከሰተውንና በሃያ ሰባት ዓመት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የሚታየውን ሙሉ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ ለመመልከት እየተዘጋጀች ነው። በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ከኢስላንድ እስከ ስፔን በሚዘልቀው የግርዶሹ መስመር ላይ በመሰባሰብ ይህንን ያልተለመደ ክስተት ለመታዘብ ይጠበቃሉ። ሳይንቲስቶችም ይህንን ብርቅዬ የጠፈር ክስተት ለመመዝገብ ልዩ አውሮፕላኖችንና የጠፈር መመልከቻዎችን እያሰማሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Awurooppaan waggoota digdamii torba keessatti markii jalqabaaf kan mul'atu guutuu tirii aduu ilaaluuf qophii gochaa jirti. Namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman Iislandii irraa hanga Ispeenitti daandii tirii aduun kun itti mul'atu irratti walga'anii raajii kana arguuf eeggachaa jiru. Qorattoonniis taatee kana qoratanii galmeessuuf xiyyaarotaa fi meeshaalee qilleensa irraa raajii kana hordofan qopheeffachaa jiru.

title: Colombia declares three days of mourning after deadly earthquake
english: Colombia has announced three days of national mourning following a massive 7.4 magnitude earthquake that claimed over 200 lives in the western part of the country. Rescue teams are currently working around the clock to find survivors trapped under debris, while thousands remain missing or injured. This disaster marks the first significant challenge for President Abelardo de la Espriella, who assumed office only days before the catastrophe occurred.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በደረሰ ከባድ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ከ200 በላይ ሰዎች መሞታቸውን ተከትሎ ሀገሪቱ የሶስት ቀናት ብሔራዊ የሀዘን ቀን አውጇል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በፍርስራሽ ስር የተጠመዱ ሰዎችን ለማግኘት ሌሊቱን ሙሉ ጥረት እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ደግሞ የደረሱበት አልታወቀም። ይህ አደጋ በቅርቡ ስልጣን በያዙት ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪኤላ ላይ የተጋረጠ የመጀመሪያው ከባድ ፈተና ሆኗል።
oromo: Kolombiyaan gadoojii biyyoolessaa guyyaa sadii kan labsite yoo ta'u, kunis raafama lafaa cimaa hanga 7.4 ga'uun namoota 200 ol ajjeesuusaatiin kan dhufedha. Gareen gargaarsaa iddoo raafamichi itti hammaatetti namoota diigama jala jiran baasuuf halkanii guyyaa hojjachaa jiru, namootni kumaan lakkaa'aman ammoo bakki buuteensaanii hin beekamu. Balaan kun pirezidaantii haaraa aangoo qabatanii guyyoota muraasa keessatti isaan qunname waan ta'eef, qormaata guddaa isaanii jalqabaati.

title: Is Russia’s economy cracking despite the Iran war windfall?
english: Russia's economy is showing signs of instability as a growing budget deficit and ongoing Ukrainian military strikes put pressure on its financial health. While rising global energy prices tied to Middle East conflicts have provided unexpected revenue, the nation's growth rate is expected to drop significantly. The United States is now attempting to further restrict Moscow's profits by imposing heavy tariffs on its energy buyers.

title: WHO chief says Trump vaccine push goes against ‘decades of evidence’
english: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus has criticized President Donald Trump’s recent efforts to overhaul childhood vaccination policies, including calls to split the MMR vaccine. Tedros emphasized that decades of scientific research consistently prove vaccines are safe and do not cause autism, contrary to claims promoted by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. The WHO chief warned that delaying or separating doses lacks medical justification and risks leaving children vulnerable to preventable diseases.

title: Members of Trump's cabinet remained on decoy plane, after president's quiet exit
english: Last month, President Donald Trump secretly switched aircraft in Turkey to avoid a potential security threat from Iran, leaving a decoy plane behind. While Trump departed on a separate military flight, key cabinet members like Marco Rubio and Scott Bessent stayed on the original plane to ensure a clear line of succession if an emergency occurred. The President stated that the military and Secret Service orchestrated this deception to ensure his safety during his travels.

title: Danube river's low water levels reveal remains of WWII soldiers and motorcycle
english: Severe drought has caused water levels in the Danube River to drop, exposing the remains of two German World War II soldiers and their motorcycle. Along with the bodies, investigators recovered personal identification tags, military badges, and unexploded anti-tank mines near Budapest. Experts are now working to identify the individuals to finally provide closure to their long-waiting families.
